<script>(() => {
  'use strict';

  const ready = (callback) => {
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', callback, { once: true });
    } else {
      callback();
    }
  };

  ready(() => {
    const body = document.body;
    const toggle = document.getElementById('adminFloatingToggle');
    const menu = document.getElementById('adminFloatingMenu');
    const backdrop = document.getElementById('adminNavBackdrop');

    if (toggle && menu) {
      const setOpen = (open) => {
        const next = Boolean(open);
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', next ? 'true' : 'false');
        menu.classList.toggle('is-open', next);
        menu.setAttribute('aria-hidden', next ? 'false' : 'true');
        backdrop?.classList.toggle('is-open', next);
        body?.classList.toggle('admin-nav-open', next);
      };

      toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
        setOpen(toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true');
      });
      backdrop?.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(false));
      menu.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('a')) setOpen(false);
      });
      document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false);
      });
      window.addEventListener('pageshow', () => setOpen(false));
    }

    // Mark existing scroll containers consistently without changing table markup.
    document.querySelectorAll('.table-wrap, .auditTableWrap, .table-responsive, .responsive-table, .table-container')
      .forEach((node) => node.classList.add('admin-scroll-region'));
  });
})();

</script>

<script>/* Shared Dashboard customer search: calculations intentionally retain Dashboard semantics. */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const normalizeOpdKey = v => {
    const digits=String(v??'').trim().replace(/\D/g,'');
    if(!digits)return ''; const opd=digits.padStart(4,'0').slice(-4); return opd==='0000'?'':opd;
  };
  function indexRecords(records){
    const map=new Map();
    records.forEach(r=>{
      const opd=normalizeOpdKey(r.opd);
      const key=opd?`opd:${opd}`:`np:${String(r.name??'').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ').toLowerCase()}|${String(r.phone??'').replace(/\D/g,'')}`;
      if(!map.has(key))map.set(key,[]);map.get(key).push(r);
    });
    map.forEach(rows=>rows.sort((a,b)=>String(b.date||'').localeCompare(String(a.date||''))));
    return map;
  }
  function query(records, filters={}){
    const {nameInput='',startDate='',endDate='',minTotal=0,maxTotal=Infinity,minVisits=0,maxVisits=Infinity,minAbsent=0,maxAbsent=Infinity,minAvg=0,maxAvg=Infinity,selectedProducts=[]}=filters;
    const grouped = {};
    const today = new Date();

    const allRecordsByCustomerKey = indexRecords(records);
    allRecordsByCustomerKey.forEach((records, key) => {
      grouped[key] = records.slice();
    });

    const results = Object.entries(grouped).map(([key, records]) => {
      const name = records[0].name;

      const totalVisits = records.length;
      const paidRecords = records.filter(r => parseFloat(r.amount || 0) > 0);
      const paidVisits = paidRecords.length;
      const totalAmount = paidRecords.reduce((sum, r) => sum + parseFloat(r.amount), 0);
      const averageBill = paidVisits > 0 ? totalAmount / paidVisits : 0;

      const latestRecord = records.reduce((latest, r) =>
        new Date(r.date) > new Date(latest.date) ? r : latest,
        records[0]
      );

      const absentDays = Math.floor((today - new Date(latestRecord.date)) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
      const lastVisit = latestRecord.date;

      const allProducts = records.flatMap(r => r.items || []).map(item => {
        const match = item.match(/\((.*?)\)/);
        return match ? match[1] : item.split(" - ")[0].trim();
      });

      return { key, name, opd: normalizeOpdKey(records[0]?.opd), totalAmount, totalVisits, paidVisits, averageBill, absentDays, lastVisit, products: allProducts };
    }).filter(c => {
      const nameMatch = !nameInput || c.name.toLowerCase().includes(nameInput);
      const totalMatch = c.totalAmount >= minTotal && c.totalAmount <= maxTotal;
      const visitMatch = c.totalVisits >= minVisits && c.totalVisits <= maxVisits;
      const absentMatch = c.absentDays >= minAbsent && c.absentDays <= maxAbsent;
      const avgMatch = c.averageBill >= minAvg && c.averageBill <= maxAvg;
      const dateMatch = (!startDate || new Date(c.lastVisit) >= new Date(startDate)) && (!endDate || new Date(c.lastVisit) <= new Date(endDate));
      const productMatch = selectedProducts.length === 0 || selectedProducts.every(p => c.products.some(prod => prod.includes(p)));
      return nameMatch && totalMatch && visitMatch && absentMatch && avgMatch && dateMatch && productMatch;
    }).sort((a, b) => b.totalAmount - a.totalAmount);


    return results;
  }
  let cache=null,stamp=0,pending=null;
  function setRecords(records){if(Array.isArray(records)){cache=records;stamp=Date.now();}}
  async function load(){
    if(cache && Date.now()-stamp<60000)return cache;
    if(pending)return pending;
    pending=(async()=>{
      const res=await fetch('/api/sales',{credentials:'same-origin',headers:{Accept:'application/json'}});
      if(!res.ok)throw new Error('โหลดรายชื่อลูกค้าไม่สำเร็จ กรุณาลองใหม่');
      const data=await res.json();
      if(!Array.isArray(data))throw new Error('กรุณาเข้าสู่ระบบใหม่ แล้วลองอีกครั้ง');
      setRecords(data);return data;
    })();
    try{return await pending;}finally{pending=null;}
  }
  window.SumoCustomerSearch={query,load,setRecords,indexRecords,products:{
    "โบทอค": ["Aestox 50 u", "Aestox 100 u", "Allergan 50 u", "Allergan 100 u"],
    "ฟิลเลอร์": ["Neuramis สีดำ", "Neuramis สีทอง", "E.P.T.Q", "Restylane"],
    "งานผิว": ["Meso Chanel", "P - Cell", "Aquatic", "Hestina", "Exosome", "Rejuran", "Belotero Revive", "Sculptra", "Juvelook", "Aesthefill"],
    "ดริปผิว": ["Snow White", "Super Aurawhite", "Vitamin Mix", "Brain Booster", "Energy Booster"],
    "ทรีทเม้นท์": ["ทรีทเมนต์หน้าใส", "ทรีทเมนต์สิว", "ทรีทเมนต์ฝ้า"],
    "ลดไขมัน": ["Bromi", "Sisi", "HIFU", "HIFU แถม"],
    "อื่นๆ": ["ยาฉีดสลายฝ้า", "ครีมทาฝ้า", "ยาทานฝ้า", "ไหมลิฟท์กรอบหน้า", "ไหม PDO", "ไหม Collagen"]
  }};
})();

</script>

        </div>

        <div style="margin-top:10px;">
          <label style="font-weight:900; display:block; margin-bottom:6px;">โน้ต</label>
          <input type="text" class="ipt" id="rosterNote" placeholder="เช่น เวรเช้า / ลากิจ">
        </div>

        <button class="btn btn-primary" style="width:100%; margin-top:12px;" onclick="Roster.save()">บันทึกรายการ</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="modal" id="confirmModal">
    <div class="modal-box" style="max-width:360px;">
      <div class="modal-body" style="text-align:center; padding-top:22px;">
        <div style="font-weight:900; margin-bottom:10px;">ยืนยันการทำรายการ</div>
        <div style="color:#64748b; margin-bottom:16px;">ต้องการลบรายการนี้ถาวรใช่หรือไม่?</div>
        <div style="display:flex; justify-content:center; gap:10px; margin-top:12px;">
          <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="Modal.close('confirmModal')">ยกเลิก</button>
          <button class="btn btn-danger" id="confirmYesBtn">ลบถาวร</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    // --- Utilities ---
    const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);

    const safeText = (v) => (v ?? '').toString();
    const trim = (v) => safeText(v).trim();

    const pad2 = (n) => String(n).padStart(2,'0');
    const toYMD = (d) => `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth()+1)}-${pad2(d.getDate())}`;

    const colName = (c) => {
      const m = { 1:'แพทย์ 1', 2:'แพทย์ 2', 3:'Treat', 4:'IV' };
      return m[Number(c)] || `ช่อง ${c}`;
    };

    const escapeHtml = (v) => safeText(v)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
      .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
      .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
      .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
      .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');

    const normalizePhone = (v) => safeText(v).replace(/\D/g, '');
    const normalizeTime = (v) => {
      const s = trim(v);
      return s.length >= 5 ? s.slice(0,5) : s;
    };

    const isUuidValue = (v) => /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(trim(v));
    const normalizeOpdValue = (v) => {
      const d = trim(v).replace(/\D/g, '');
      return d ? d.padStart(4, '0').slice(-4) : '';
    };

    const api = async (url, method='GET', body=null) => {
      const opts = { method, headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'} };
      if(body) opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);

      try {
        const res = await fetch(url, opts);

        let data = null;
        const ct = res.headers.get('content-type') || '';
        if(ct.includes('application/json')) {
          data = await res.json().catch(()=>null);
        } else {
          const text = await res.text().catch(()=> '');
          data = text ? { message: text } : null;
        }

        if(!res.ok) {
          const msg = (data && (data.error || data.message || data.detail)) ?
            (data.error || data.message || data.detail) : `HTTP ${res.status}`;
          return { __http_ok:false, __status: res.status, __error: msg, __data: data };
        }

        return data;
      } catch(e) {
        console.warn('API Fetch Error:', e);
        return { __http_ok:false, __status:0, __error:'เชื่อมต่อระบบไม่สำเร็จ', __data:null };
      }
    };

    // --- Toast ---
    const Toast = {
      show(msg, type='success') {
        const c = $('toast-container');
        const el = document.createElement('div');
        el.className = `toast ${type}`;
        el.innerHTML = `<span>${escapeHtml(msg)}</span> <span style="cursor:pointer;font-weight:900;" onclick="this.parentElement.remove()">×</span>`;
        c.appendChild(el);
        setTimeout(() => { el.remove(); }, 2500);
      }
    };

    // --- Modal ---
    const Modal = {
      open(id) { $(id).classList.add('show'); },
      close(id) { $(id).classList.remove('show'); },
      closeBackdrop(e, id) { if(e.target.id === id) this.close(id); },

      openAppt(data = null) {
        $('apptId').value = '';
        $('apptCustId').value = '';
        $('apptStatus').value = 'pending';

        $('searchCustInput').value = '';
        $('guestPhone').value = '';
        $('apptProc').value = '';
        $('apptNote').value = '';
        $('searchDropdown').style.display = 'none';

        $('apptDate').value = $('dailyDatepicker').value || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
        $('apptTime').value = '11:00';
        $('apptCol').value = '1';

        if(data) {
          if(data.id) {
            $('apptModalTitle').innerText = 'จัดการนัดหมาย';
            $('apptId').value = data.id;
            $('apptDate').value = data.appt_date;
            $('apptTime').value = (data.start_time || '').substring(0,5);
            $('apptCol').value = String(data.column_id || '1');
            $('apptProc').value = data.procedure || data.service || '';
            $('apptNote').value = data.note || '';
            $('apptStatus').value = data.status || 'pending';

            $('searchCustInput').value = data.customer_name || data.guest_name || data.opd || '';
            $('guestPhone').value = data.guest_phone || data.phone || '';
            $('apptCustId').value = data.customer_id || data.opd || '';
          } else {
            $('apptModalTitle').innerText = 'ลงนัดหมายใหม่';
            $('apptStatus').value = 'pending';
            if(data.time) $('apptTime').value = data.time;
            if(data.col) $('apptCol').value = String(data.col);
            if(data.appt_date) $('apptDate').value = data.appt_date;
          }
        } else {
          $('apptModalTitle').innerText = 'ลงนัดหมายใหม่';
        }

        this.renderButtons();
        this.open('apptModal');
      },

      renderButtons() {
        const isEdit = !!$('apptId').value;

        const btnConfirm = isEdit
          ? `<button class="btn btn-success" onclick="Daily.setStatusUI('confirmed')">✅ คอนเฟิร์ม</button>` : '';

        const btnBackPending = isEdit
          ? `<button class="btn btn-warning" onclick="Daily.setStatusUI('pending')">↩ กลับเป็น Pending</button>` : '';

        const btnCancelAppt = isEdit
          ? `<button class="btn btn-danger" onclick="Daily.setStatusUI('cancelled')">⛔ ยกเลิกนัด</button>` : '';

        const btnDeleteHard = isEdit
          ? `<button class="btn btn-ghost" style="color:#ef4444;" onclick="Daily.confirmDelete()">ลบถาวร</button>` : '';

        const btnClose = `<button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="Modal.close('apptModal')">ปิด</button>`;
        const btnSave = `<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="Daily.save()">บันทึก</button>`;

        $('apptModalFtr').innerHTML =
          `${btnDeleteHard} ${btnCancelAppt} ${btnBackPending} ${btnConfirm} ${btnClose} ${btnSave}`;
      }
    };

    // --- Search System ---
    const Search = {
      timer: null,
      toggleType() {
        const type = $('customerTypeSelect').value;
        if(type === 'new') {
          $('searchDropdown').style.display = 'none';
          $('apptCustId').value = '';
        }
      },
      handleInput(value) {
        const type = $('customerTypeSelect').value;
        if(type !== 'old') return;

        clearTimeout(this.timer);
        this.timer = setTimeout(() => this.search(value), 300);
      },
      async search(q) {
        if(!q || q.length < 1) {
          $('searchDropdown').style.display = 'none';
          return;
        }
        const res = await api(`/api/search_customer_simple?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`);
        if(!Array.isArray(res)) return;

        const box = $('searchDropdown');
        box.innerHTML = '';

        res.forEach(r => {
          const div = document.createElement('div');
          div.className = 'search-item';
          div.innerHTML = `<strong class="customer-name-color" data-name-color-opd="${escapeHtml(r.opd || '')}">${escapeHtml(r.display_name)}</strong><small>${escapeHtml(r.phone || '-')}</small>`;
          div.onclick = () => {
            $('searchCustInput').value = r.display_name;
            $('guestPhone').value = r.phone || '';
            $('apptCustId').value = r.opd || '';
            box.style.display = 'none';
          };
          box.appendChild(div);
        });
        box.style.display = 'block';
      }
    };

    // --- Daily ---
    const Daily = {
      _loadedAppts: [],
      _inited: false,

      init() {
        if(this._inited) return;
        this._inited = true;
        const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
        $('dailyDatepicker').value = today;
        $('dailyDatepicker').addEventListener('change', () => this.load());
        this.load();
      },

      shiftDay(delta) {
        const cur = $('dailyDatepicker').value || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
        const d = new Date(cur + 'T00:00:00');
        d.setDate(d.getDate() + delta);
        $('dailyDatepicker').value = toYMD(d);
        this.load();
      },

      goPrevDay() { this.shiftDay(-1); },
      goNextDay() { this.shiftDay(1); },

      goToday() {
        $('dailyDatepicker').value = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
        this.load();
      },

      async load() {
        const date = $('dailyDatepicker').value;
        $('dailyHeaderTitle').innerText = `ตารางนัดวันที่ ${this.formatDateTH(date)}`;

        const tbody = $('dailyTableBody');
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center;color:#64748b;padding:16px;">กำลังโหลด...</td></tr>';

        const appts = await api(`/api/get_appointments?date=${date}`);
        if(appts && appts.__http_ok === false) {
          this._loadedAppts = [];
          tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center;color:#ef4444;padding:16px;">โหลดไม่สำเร็จ: ${escapeHtml(appts.__error)}</td></tr>`;
          return;
        }
        this._loadedAppts = Array.isArray(appts) ? appts : [];
        this.renderTable(this._loadedAppts);
      },

      normalizeStatus(s){
        const v = (s || 'pending').toLowerCase();
        if(v === 'confirm' || v === 'confirmed') return 'confirmed';
        if(v === 'cancel' || v === 'canceled' || v === 'cancelled') return 'cancelled';
        return 'pending';
      },

      timeKey(t){ return normalizeTime(t); },

      resolveDisplayName(a){
        return trim(a.customer_name) || trim(a.guest_name) || trim(a.display_name) || trim(a.opd) || 'ไม่ระบุชื่อ';
      },

      isSameSlot(a, appt_date, start_time, column_id){
        return safeText(a.appt_date) === safeText(appt_date)
          && this.timeKey(a.start_time) === this.timeKey(start_time)
          && String(a.column_id) === String(column_id)
          && this.normalizeStatus(a.status) !== 'cancelled';
      },

      async hasSlotConflict(appt_date, start_time, column_id, selfId=''){
        let rows = this._loadedAppts;
        if($('dailyDatepicker').value !== appt_date) {
          const res = await api(`/api/get_appointments?date=${encodeURIComponent(appt_date)}`);
          if(res && res.__http_ok === false) return { blocked:true, error:res.__error };
          rows = Array.isArray(res) ? res : [];
        }

        const conflict = rows.find(a =>
          this.isSameSlot(a, appt_date, start_time, column_id)
          && String(a.id || '') !== String(selfId || '')
        );
        return { blocked: !!conflict, row: conflict || null };
      },

      renderTable(appts) {
        const tbody = $('dailyTableBody');
        tbody.innerHTML = '';

        const times = [];
        for(let h=11; h<20; h++) {
          times.push(`${pad2(h)}:00`);
          times.push(`${pad2(h)}:30`);
        }

        const idx = new Map();
        (appts || []).forEach(a => {
          const k = `${this.timeKey(a.start_time)}|${String(a.column_id)}`;
          if(!idx.has(k)) idx.set(k, []);
          idx.get(k).push(a);
        });

        times.forEach(t => {
          const tr = document.createElement('tr');
          const tdTime = document.createElement('td');
          tdTime.className = 'timeCell';
          tdTime.innerText = t;
          tr.appendChild(tdTime);

          for(let c=1; c<=4; c++) {
            const td = document.createElement('td');
            const foundList = idx.get(`${t}|${String(c)}`) || [];

            if(foundList.length) {
              const stack = document.createElement('div');
              stack.className = 'apptStack';

              foundList.forEach(found => {
                const nameDisplay = this.resolveDisplayName(found);
                const st = this.normalizeStatus(found.status);
                const phone = found.guest_phone || found.phone || '';
                const service = found.service || found.procedure || '-';

                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = `apptCard ${st}`;
                div.innerHTML = `
                  <div class="name customer-name-color" data-name-color-opd="${escapeHtml(found.opd || '')}" title="${escapeHtml(nameDisplay)}">${escapeHtml(nameDisplay)}</div>
                  <div class="meta" title="${escapeHtml(phone)}">${escapeHtml(phone)}</div>
                  <div class="svc" title="${escapeHtml(service)}">${escapeHtml(service)}</div>
                `;
                div.onclick = () => Modal.openAppt(found);
                stack.appendChild(div);
              });

              td.appendChild(stack);
            } else {
              const div = document.createElement('div');
              div.className = 'slotEmpty';
              div.onclick = () => Modal.openAppt({ time: t, col: c, appt_date: $('dailyDatepicker').value });
              td.appendChild(div);
            }
            tr.appendChild(td);
          }
          tbody.appendChild(tr);
        });
      },

      async save() {
        const id = trim($('apptId').value);
        const appt_date = trim($('apptDate').value);
        const start_time = trim($('apptTime').value);
        const column_id = parseInt(trim($('apptCol').value || '0'), 10);
        const service = trim($('apptProc').value);
        const note = trim($('apptNote').value);
        const status = this.normalizeStatus(trim($('apptStatus').value) || 'pending');
        const customer_name = trim($('searchCustInput').value);
        const guest_phone = trim($('guestPhone').value);
        const customer_type = $('customerTypeSelect').value;
        const customer_ref = trim($('apptCustId').value);
        const customer_id = isUuidValue(customer_ref) ? customer_ref : '';
        const opd = customer_id ? '' : normalizeOpdValue(customer_ref);

        if(!customer_name) return Toast.show('กรุณากรอกชื่อลูกค้า', 'error');
        if(!appt_date) return Toast.show('กรุณาเลือกวันที่', 'error');
        if(!start_time) return Toast.show('กรุณาเลือกเวลา', 'error');
        if(!column_id) return Toast.show('กรุณาเลือกช่อง', 'error');
        if(!service) return Toast.show('กรุณากรอกหัตถการ', 'error');

        const conflict = await this.hasSlotConflict(appt_date, start_time, column_id, id);
        if(conflict.error) return Toast.show(`ตรวจคิวซ้ำไม่สำเร็จ: ${conflict.error}`, 'error');
        if(conflict.blocked) {
          const who = this.resolveDisplayName(conflict.row);
          return Toast.show(`ช่องนี้มีคิวแล้ว: ${who}`, 'error');
        }

        const payload = {
          appt_date,
          start_time,
          end_time: start_time,
          column_id,
          service,
          note,
          status,
          customer_name,
          guest_phone: guest_phone || null,
          customer_type,
          customer_id: customer_id || null,
          opd: opd || null
        };

        if(id) payload.id = id;

        const res = await api('/api/save_appointment', 'POST', payload);

        if(res && res.success) {
          Toast.show(id ? 'อัปเดตนัดสำเร็จ' : 'บันทึกสำเร็จ');
          Modal.close('apptModal');
          this.load();
          MonthQueue.reloadCurrentRange();
        } else {
          const msg = res && res.__http_ok === false ? res.__error : (res && res.error) || 'เกิดข้อผิดพลาด';
          Toast.show(msg, 'error');
        }
      },

      async setStatusUI(status){
        const id = trim($('apptId').value);
        if(!id) return Toast.show('ยังไม่มีรายการ', 'error');

        const s = this.normalizeStatus(status);
        const r = await this.setStatus(id, s);

        if(r.ok){
          $('apptStatus').value = s;
          const msg = s === 'confirmed' ? 'คอนเฟิร์มแล้ว' : s === 'cancelled' ? 'ยกเลิกนัดแล้ว' : 'กลับเป็น Pending แล้ว';
          const t = s === 'confirmed' ? 'success' : s === 'cancelled' ? 'error' : 'warn';

          Toast.show(msg, t);
          Modal.close('apptModal');
          this.load();
          MonthQueue.reloadCurrentRange();
        } else {
          Toast.show(`เปลี่ยนสถานะไม่สำเร็จ: ${r.error || 'unknown'}`, 'error');
        }
      },

      async setStatus(id, status){
        const res = await api('/api/set_appointment_status', 'POST', { id, status });
        if(res && res.__http_ok === false) return { ok:false, error: res.__error };
        if(res && (res.success === true || res.ok === true || res.row)) return { ok:true };
        return { ok:false, error:'bad_response' };
      },

      confirmDelete() {
        const id = trim($('apptId').value);
        if(!id) return;
        $('confirmYesBtn').onclick = () => this.doDelete(id);
        Modal.open('confirmModal');
      },

      async doDelete(id) {
        const res = await api('/api/delete_appointment', 'POST', {id: id});
        if(res && res.__http_ok === false) return Toast.show(`ลบไม่สำเร็จ: ${res.__error}`, 'error');

        if(res && res.success) {
          Toast.show('ลบรายการสำเร็จ');
          Modal.close('confirmModal');
          Modal.close('apptModal');
          this.load();
          MonthQueue.reloadCurrentRange();
        } else {
          Toast.show('ลบไม่สำเร็จ', 'error');
        }
      },

      formatDateTH(dateStr) {
        if(!dateStr) return '';
        const d = new Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00');
        return d.toLocaleDateString('th-TH', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
      }
    };

    // --- Month Queue ---
    const MonthQueue = {
      _loading: false,
      _cacheData: [],
      _rowMap: {},
      _currentStartDate: null,
      _currentEndDate: null,
      _lastQueryKey: '',
      _filterTimer: null,

      normalizeStatus(s){
        const v = (s || 'pending').toLowerCase();
        if(v === 'confirm' || v === 'confirmed') return 'confirmed';
        if(v === 'cancel' || v === 'canceled' || v === 'cancelled') return 'cancelled';
        return 'pending';
      },

      pillStatus(st){
        if(st === 'confirmed') return `<span class="pill pill-confirmed">✅ Confirmed</span>`;
        if(st === 'cancelled') return `<span class="pill pill-cancelled">⛔ Cancelled</span>`;
        return `<span class="pill pill-pending">⏳ Pending</span>`;
      },

      openByKey(k){
        const a = this._rowMap[k];
        if(a) Modal.openAppt(a);
      },

      goToday(){
        const el = document.querySelector('[data-mq-today="1"]');
        if(el) {
          el.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'start' });
        } else {
          $('mqWrap').scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'start' });
        }
      },

      renderFromCache(){
        this.updateFilterButtonState();
        this.render();
      },

      toggleFilters(force){
        const box = $('mqFilters');
        const btn = $('btnToggleFilters');
        if(!box) return;
        const open = (typeof force === 'boolean') ? force : !box.classList.contains('is-open');
        box.classList.toggle('is-open', open);
        if(btn) btn.classList.toggle('active', open);
        if(open){
          setTimeout(()=> $('mqFilterText')?.focus(), 40);
        }
      },

      resetFilters(){
        const range = $('mqFilterRange');
        const status = $('mqFilterStatus');
        const column = $('mqFilterColumn');
        const type = $('mqFilterType');
        const text = $('mqFilterText');

        if(range) range.value = 'default';
        if(status) status.value = 'all';
        if(column) column.value = 'all';
        if(type) type.value = 'all';
        if(text) text.value = '';
        if($('mqCustomStart')) $('mqCustomStart').value = '';
        if($('mqCustomEnd')) $('mqCustomEnd').value = '';
        this.syncCustomRangeUI();

        this.updateFilterButtonState();
        this.load(true);
      },

      hasActiveFilters(){
        return (($('mqFilterRange')?.value || 'default') !== 'default') ||
          (($('mqFilterStatus')?.value || 'all') !== 'all') ||
          (($('mqFilterColumn')?.value || 'all') !== 'all') ||
          (($('mqFilterType')?.value || 'all') !== 'all') ||
          !!trim($('mqFilterText')?.value || '');
      },

      updateFilterButtonState(){
        const btn = $('btnToggleFilters');
        if(btn) btn.classList.toggle('has-filter', this.hasActiveFilters());
      },

      resolveDisplayName(a){
        return trim(a.customer_name) || trim(a.guest_name) || trim(a.display_name) || trim(a.opd) || 'ไม่ระบุชื่อ';
      },

      refreshLoadedRange(){ return this.load(true); },

      onFilterChange(kind){
        // ถ้าเลือก “ยกเลิกแล้ว” ให้ค้นประวัติทั้งหมดทันที ไม่ติดช่วงค่าเริ่มต้นที่เริ่มวันนี้
        if(kind === 'status' && ($('mqFilterStatus')?.value || '') === 'cancelled') {
          this.setRangeMode('all');
          Toast.show('กำลังค้นประวัติยกเลิกทั้งหมด', 'warn');
        }
        this.updateFilterButtonState();
        this.load(true);
      },

      onFilterTextInput(){
        clearTimeout(this._filterTimer);
        this._filterTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          this.updateFilterButtonState();
          this.load(true);
        }, 260);
      },

      selectedRangeMode(){
        return $('mqFilterRange')?.value || 'default';
      },

      setRangeMode(mode){
        const el = $('mqFilterRange');
        if(el) el.value = mode;
        this.syncCustomRangeUI();
      },

      syncCustomRangeUI(){
        const box = $('mqCustomRangeBox');
        const isCustom = this.selectedRangeMode() === 'custom';
        if(box) box.classList.toggle('is-open', isCustom);
      },

      customRangeValues(){
        return {
          start: trim($('mqCustomStart')?.value || ''),
          end: trim($('mqCustomEnd')?.value || '')
        };
      },

      setDefaultCustomDates(){
        const now = new Date();
        const start = $('mqCustomStart');
        const end = $('mqCustomEnd');
        if(start && !start.value) start.value = toYMD(new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1));
        if(end && !end.value) end.value = toYMD(now);
      },

      async applyCustomRange(){
        this.setRangeMode('custom');
        const {start, end} = this.customRangeValues();
        if(!start || !end) return Toast.show('กรุณาเลือกวันที่เริ่มต้นและสิ้นสุด', 'error');
        if(new Date(start + 'T00:00:00') > new Date(end + 'T00:00:00')) {
          return Toast.show('วันที่เริ่มต้นต้องไม่เกินวันที่สิ้นสุด', 'error');
        }
        this._cacheData = [];
        this._lastQueryKey = '';
        await this.load(true);
      },

      showCustomRangePrompt(){
        const list = $('mqList');
        this._cacheData = [];
        this._currentStartDate = null;
        this._currentEndDate = null;
        $('sumToday').innerText = `0 เคส`;
        $('sumRemain').innerText = `0 เคส`;
        $('sumPending').innerText = `0 เคส`;
        $('sumConfirmed').innerText = `0 เคส`;
        if($('sumCancelled')) $('sumCancelled').innerText = `0 เคส`;
        if(list) list.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:16px; text-align:center; color:#1e3a8a; font-weight:900; background:#eff6ff; border:1px solid #dbeafe; border-radius:12px;">เลือกวันที่เริ่มต้นและสิ้นสุด แล้วกด “ค้นหาช่วงนี้”</div>`;
      },

      rangeForMode(mode){
        const now = new Date();

        // ค่าเริ่มต้น = แบบเดิม: เริ่มจากวันนี้ ไล่ไปจนถึงสิ้นเดือน
        if(mode === 'default') {
          return {
            startD: new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()),
            endD: new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 0)
          };
        }

        // เดือนนี้ = ตั้งแต่วันที่ 1 ถึงสิ้นเดือนปัจจุบัน
        if(mode === 'month') {
          return {
            startD: new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1),
            endD: new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 0)
          };
        }

        // ปีนี้ = ตั้งแต่ 1 ม.ค. ถึง 31 ธ.ค. ปีปัจจุบัน
        if(mode === 'year') {
          return {
            startD: new Date(now.getFullYear(), 0, 1),
            endD: new Date(now.getFullYear(), 11, 31)
          };
        }

        // ทั้งหมด = ให้ backend ค้นทั้งตาราง appointments โดยตรง
        // ไม่อิง cache ที่โหลดอยู่ จึงหาเคสยกเลิก/ประวัติเก่าทั้งหมดได้จริง
        if(mode === 'all') {
          return { startD: null, endD: null };
        }

        // เลือกช่วงเวลา = ผู้ใช้กำหนดเอง
        if(mode === 'custom') {
          const {start, end} = this.customRangeValues();
          if(!start || !end) return { startD: null, endD: null, missingCustomRange: true };
          return {
            startD: new Date(start + 'T00:00:00'),
            endD: new Date(end + 'T00:00:00')
          };
        }

        return {
          startD: new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()),
          endD: new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 0)
        };
      },

      async onRangeFilterChange(){
        this.syncCustomRangeUI();
        this.updateFilterButtonState();
        this._cacheData = [];
        this._lastQueryKey = '';

        if(this.selectedRangeMode() === 'custom') {
          this.setDefaultCustomDates();
          this.showCustomRangePrompt();
          setTimeout(()=> $('mqCustomStart')?.focus(), 40);
          return;
        }

        await this.load(true);
      },

      getFilters(){
        return {
          status: $('mqFilterStatus')?.value || 'all',
          column: $('mqFilterColumn')?.value || 'all',
          type: $('mqFilterType')?.value || 'all',
          text: trim($('mqFilterText')?.value || '').toLowerCase()
        };
      },

      itemPassesFilters(a, f){
        const st = this.normalizeStatus(a.status);
        if(f.status !== 'all' && st !== f.status) return false;

        const col = String(a.column_id || '');
        if(f.column === 'doctor') {
          if(col !== '1' && col !== '2') return false;
        } else if(f.column !== 'all' && col !== f.column) {
          return false;
        }

        const typ = (a.customer_type === 'old') ? 'old' : 'new';
        if(f.type !== 'all' && typ !== f.type) return false;

        if(f.text) {
          const hay = [
            this.resolveDisplayName(a),
            a.guest_phone || a.phone || '',
            a.service || a.procedure || '',
            a.opd || '',
            colName(a.column_id)
          ].join(' ').toLowerCase();
          if(!hay.includes(f.text) && !normalizePhone(hay).includes(normalizePhone(f.text))) return false;
        }

        return true;
      },

      async load(force=false){
        if(this._loading) return;

        const selectedMode = this.selectedRangeMode();
        const filters = this.getFilters();
        const queryKey = JSON.stringify({ mode:selectedMode, filters });

        if(!force && this._cacheData.length > 0 && this._lastQueryKey === queryKey) {
          this.render();
          return;
        }

        this._loading = true;
        this._lastQueryKey = queryKey;
        const list = $('mqList');
        list.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:16px; text-align:center; color:#64748b;">กำลังค้นคิวจากฐานข้อมูล...</div>`;

        try {
          const range = this.rangeForMode(selectedMode);
          if(range.missingCustomRange) {
            this.showCustomRangePrompt();
            return;
          }
          await this.fetchAndAppendRange(range.startD, range.endD, 'replace');
        } catch(e) {
          console.warn(e);
          if (this._cacheData.length === 0) {
            const msg = (e && e.message) ? e.message : 'โหลดคิวไม่สำเร็จ กรุณารีเฟรช';
            list.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:16px; text-align:center; color:#ef4444; font-weight:900;">${escapeHtml(msg)}</div>`;
          }
        } finally {
          this._loading = false;
        }
      },

      async loadPrevious() {
        if(this._loading) return;
        // ปุ่มนี้เปลี่ยนเป็นโหลดประวัติทั้งหมดจากฐานข้อมูลโดยตรง
        // เพื่อให้ค้นรายการยกเลิก/รายการเก่าทั้งหมดได้จริง ไม่ใช่แค่ cache เดือนก่อน
        this.setRangeMode('all');
        const btn = $('btnLoadPrevious');
        if(btn) btn.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#94a3b8;">กำลังโหลดทั้งหมด...</span>';
        try {
          await this.load(true);
          Toast.show('โหลดทั้งหมดแล้ว', 'success');
        } catch(e) {
          console.warn(e);
          Toast.show('โหลดทั้งหมดไม่สำเร็จ', 'error');
        } finally {
          if(btn) btn.innerHTML = '⬆️ ดูคิวก่อนหน้า';
        }
      },

      async loadMore() {
        if(this._loading) return;
        if(this.selectedRangeMode() === 'all') {
          Toast.show('โหลดทั้งหมดแล้ว', 'warn');
          return;
        }
        if(!this._currentEndDate) return;

        this._loading = true;
        const btn = $('btnLoadMore');
        if(btn) btn.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#94a3b8;">กำลังโหลดข้อมูลเดือนถัดไป...</span>';

        try {
          const startD = new Date(this._currentEndDate + 'T00:00:00');
          startD.setDate(startD.getDate() + 1);

          const y = startD.getFullYear();
          const m = startD.getMonth();
          const endD = new Date(y, m + 1, 0);

          await this.fetchAndAppendRange(startD, endD, 'append');
        } catch(e) {
          console.warn(e);
          Toast.show('โหลดคิวเดือนถัดไปไม่สำเร็จ', 'error');
          if(btn) btn.innerHTML = '⬇️ โหลดข้อมูลเดือนถัดไป';
        } finally {
          this._loading = false;
        }
      },

      async reloadCurrentRange() {
        if(!this._currentStartDate || !this._currentEndDate) return this.load(true);
        if(this._loading) return;

        this._loading = true;
        try {
          const startD = new Date(this._currentStartDate + 'T00:00:00');
          const endD = new Date(this._currentEndDate + 'T00:00:00');
          await this.fetchAndAppendRange(startD, endD, 'replace');
        } catch(e) {
          console.warn(e);
        } finally {
          this._loading = false;
        }
      },

      formatMonthTH(dateObj) {
        return dateObj.toLocaleDateString('th-TH', { month:'long', year:'numeric' });
      },

      buildDateBlocks(startStr, endStr, rows){
        const byDate = {};
        (rows || []).forEach(a => {
          const ds = safeText(a.appt_date).slice(0,10);
          if(!ds) return;
          const row = { ...a, appt_date: ds };
          if(!byDate[ds]) byDate[ds] = [];
          byDate[ds].push(row);
        });

        Object.keys(byDate).forEach(ds => {
          byDate[ds].sort((x,y) => trim(x.start_time).localeCompare(trim(y.start_time)) || String(x.column_id).localeCompare(String(y.column_id)));
        });

        // กรณีประวัติทั้งหมด: ไม่สร้างวันว่างยาว ๆ เป็นปี ให้แสดงเฉพาะวันที่มีรายการจริง
        if(!startStr || !endStr) {
          return Object.keys(byDate).sort().map(ds => ({ date: ds, items: byDate[ds] || [] }));
        }

        const dates = [];
        const d = new Date(startStr + 'T00:00:00');
        const endDObj = new Date(endStr + 'T00:00:00');
        while(d <= endDObj){
          const ds = toYMD(d);
          dates.push({ date: ds, items: byDate[ds] || [] });
          d.setDate(d.getDate()+1);
        }
        return dates;
      },

      async fetchRangeRows(startStr, endStr){
        const f = this.getFilters();
        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        if(startStr) params.set('start', startStr);
        if(endStr) params.set('end', endStr);
        params.set('range', this.selectedRangeMode());
        params.set('status', f.status);
        params.set('column', f.column);
        params.set('type', f.type);
        if(f.text) params.set('q', f.text);

        const res = await api(`/api/search_appointments?${params.toString()}`);
        if(res && res.__http_ok === false) throw new Error(res.__error || 'โหลดคิวไม่สำเร็จ');
        if(res && res.success && Array.isArray(res.rows)) return res.rows;
        if(Array.isArray(res)) return res;
        throw new Error((res && (res.error || res.message)) || 'โหลดคิวไม่สำเร็จ');
      },

      async fetchAndAppendRange(startD, endD, mode='append') {
        const startStr = startD ? toYMD(startD) : '';
        const endStr = endD ? toYMD(endD) : '';

        const rows = await this.fetchRangeRows(startStr, endStr);
        const newBlocks = this.buildDateBlocks(startStr, endStr, rows);

        if(mode === 'replace') {
          this._cacheData = [...newBlocks];
        } else if(mode === 'prepend') {
          this._cacheData = [...newBlocks, ...this._cacheData];
        } else {
          this._cacheData = [...this._cacheData, ...newBlocks];
        }

        if(this._cacheData.length > 0) {
          this._currentStartDate = this._cacheData[0].date;
          this._currentEndDate = this._cacheData[this._cacheData.length - 1].date;
        } else {
          this._currentStartDate = startStr || null;
          this._currentEndDate = endStr || null;
        }

        this.render();
      },

      render() {
        this.updateFilterButtonState();
        const hideEmpty = $('hideEmptyDays')?.checked ?? true;
        const todayStr = toYMD(new Date());
        const filters = this.getFilters();

        let todayCount = 0;
        let remainCount = 0;
        let pendingCount = 0;
        let confirmedCount = 0;
        let cancelledCount = 0;

        const visibleBlocks = this._cacheData.map(b => {
          const items = (b.items || []).filter(a => this.itemPassesFilters(a, filters));
          return { date:b.date, items };
        });

        visibleBlocks.forEach(b => {
          const items = b.items || [];
          const n = items.length;

          if(b.date === todayStr) todayCount += n;
          remainCount += n;

          items.forEach(a => {
            const st = this.normalizeStatus(a.status);
            if (st === 'pending') pendingCount++;
            if (st === 'confirmed') confirmedCount++;
            if (st === 'cancelled') cancelledCount++;
          });
        });

        $('sumToday').innerText = `${todayCount} เคส`;
        $('sumRemain').innerText = `${remainCount} เคส`;
        $('sumPending').innerText = `${pendingCount} เคส`;
        $('sumConfirmed').innerText = `${confirmedCount} เคส`;
        if($('sumCancelled')) $('sumCancelled').innerText = `${cancelledCount} เคส`;

        this._rowMap = {};
        let kCounter = 0;
        let html = '';
        let any = false;
        let currentMonthName = '';

        visibleBlocks.forEach(block => {
          const ds = block.date;
          const items = block.items || [];
          const dObj = new Date(ds + 'T00:00:00');
          const mName = dObj.toLocaleDateString('th-TH', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });

          if (mName !== currentMonthName) {
            currentMonthName = mName;
            html += `<div style="padding:10px 16px; margin: 16px 0 10px; background:#f1f5f9; border-radius:10px; font-weight:900; color:#475569; font-size:12px; border-left:4px solid #0f766e;">📅 ${escapeHtml(mName)}</div>`;
          }

          if(hideEmpty && items.length === 0) return;

          if(items.length === 0){
            const th = dObj.toLocaleDateString('th-TH', { weekday:'short', day:'numeric', month:'short' });
            html += `
              <div class="dayBlock">
                <div class="dayHdr">
                  <div class="dayTitle">${ds === todayStr ? '📌 ' : ''}${escapeHtml(th)}</div>
                  <div class="dayCount">(0 เคส)</div>
                </div>
                <div style="padding:10px; color:#94a3b8; text-align:center; font-weight:800;">- ไม่มีคิว -</div>
              </div>
            `;
            return;
          }

          any = true;
          const isToday = (ds === todayStr);
          const th = dObj.toLocaleDateString('th-TH', { weekday:'short', day:'numeric', month:'short' });

          html += `
            <div class="dayBlock" ${isToday ? 'data-mq-today="1"' : ''}>
              <div class="dayHdr">
                <div class="dayTitle">${isToday ? '📌 ' : ''}${escapeHtml(th)} (${escapeHtml(ds)})</div>
                <div class="dayCount">(${items.length} เคส)</div>
              </div>

              <div class="tableWrap">
                <table class="qTable">
                  <thead>
                    <tr>
                      <th style="text-align:left;">เวลา</th>
                      <th style="text-align:left;">ช่อง</th>
                      <th style="text-align:left;">ลูกค้า</th>
                      <th style="text-align:left;">หัตถการ</th>
                      <th style="text-align:left;">เบอร์โทร</th>
                      <th style="text-align:left;">ประเภท</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
          `;

          items.forEach(a => {
            const st = this.normalizeStatus(a.status);
            const time = normalizeTime(a.start_time) || '-';
            const col = colName(a.column_id);
            const nameDisplay = this.resolveDisplayName(a);
            const svc = a.service || a.procedure || '-';
            const key = `k${++kCounter}`;
            this._rowMap[key] = a;

            const customerType = a.customer_type === 'old' ? 'เก่า' : 'ใหม่';
            const phone = a.guest_phone || a.phone || '-';
            const nameBandClass = st === 'confirmed' ? 'confirmed' : (st === 'cancelled' ? 'cancelled' : 'pending');

            html += `
              <tr class="rowClickable" onclick="MonthQueue.openByKey('${key}')">
                <td>${escapeHtml(time)}</td>
                <td>${escapeHtml(col)}</td>
                <td class="nameCell" title="${escapeHtml(nameDisplay)}"><span class="nameStatusBand ${nameBandClass} customer-name-color" data-name-color-opd="${escapeHtml(a.opd || '')}">${escapeHtml(nameDisplay)}</span></td>
                <td title="${escapeHtml(svc)}">${escapeHtml(svc)}</td>
                <td>${escapeHtml(phone)}</td>
                <td>${escapeHtml(customerType)}</td>
              </tr>
            `;
          });

          html += `
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          `;
        });

        if(!any && hideEmpty){
          html += `<div style="padding:16px; text-align:center; color:#64748b; font-weight:800;">- ไม่มีคิวในช่วงเวลาที่แสดงผล -</div>`;
        }

        if(this.selectedRangeMode() === 'all') {
          html += `<div style="padding:12px; text-align:center; color:#64748b; font-weight:900;">แสดงประวัติทั้งหมดที่ตรงกับฟิลเตอร์แล้ว</div>`;
        } else {
          html += `
            <div style="display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:10px;">
              <button id="btnLoadMore" class="btn btn-ghost" style="flex:1 1 240px; padding:12px; border: 1px dashed #cbd5e1; background: #f8fafc; color: #475569; font-weight:900;" onclick="MonthQueue.loadMore()">
                ⬇️ โหลดข้อมูลเดือนถัดไป
              </button>
            </div>
          `;
        }

        $('mqList').innerHTML = html;
      }
    };

    // --- ROSTER ---
    const Roster = {
      staffs: [],
      currentShifts: [],
      _inited: false,

      init() {
        if(this._inited) return;
        this._inited = true;
        const d = new Date();
        $('monthPicker').value = `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth()+1)}`;
        $('monthPicker').addEventListener('change', ()=>this.load());
        this.loadStaffs();
      },

      goToday() {
        const d = new Date();
        $('monthPicker').value = `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth()+1)}`;
        this.load();
      },

      async loadStaffs() {
        this.staffs = await api('/api/staffs');
        const sel = $('rosterStaffId');
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- เลือกพนักงาน --</option>';

        if(this.staffs && this.staffs.__http_ok === false) {
          sel.innerHTML = `<option value="">โหลดพนักงานไม่สำเร็จ</option>`;
          return;
        }

        if(Array.isArray(this.staffs)) {
          this.staffs.forEach(s => {
            sel.innerHTML += `<option value="${escapeHtml(s.id)}">${escapeHtml(s.name)} (${escapeHtml(s.role)})</option>`;
          });
        }
      },

      async load() {
        const ym = $('monthPicker').value;
        if(!ym) return;
        const [y, m] = ym.split('-');
        $('monthTitle').innerText = new Date(y, m-1, 1).toLocaleDateString('th-TH', {month:'long', year:'numeric'});
        $('monthGrid').innerHTML = '<div style="grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:16px;color:#64748b;font-weight:800;">โหลดตารางเวร...</div>';

        const shifts = await api(`/api/get_roster?month=${encodeURIComponent(ym)}`);

        if(shifts && shifts.__http_ok === false) {
          $('monthGrid').innerHTML = `<div style="grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:16px;color:#ef4444;font-weight:800;">โหลดไม่สำเร็จ: ${escapeHtml(shifts.__error)}</div>`;
          return;
        }

        this.renderCalendar(Number(y), Number(m), Array.isArray(shifts) ? shifts : []);
      },

      renderCalendar(y, m, shifts) {
        const grid = $('monthGrid'); grid.innerHTML='';
        const firstDay = new Date(y, m-1, 1).getDay();
        const daysInMonth = new Date(y, m, 0).getDate();
        const shiftsByDate = new Map();

        (shifts || []).forEach(s => {
          const ds = safeText(s.date).slice(0,10);
          if(!shiftsByDate.has(ds)) shiftsByDate.set(ds, []);
          shiftsByDate.get(ds).push(s);
        });

        for(let i=0; i<firstDay; i++) grid.innerHTML+=`<div class="iosDay" style="background:#f8fafc;"></div>`;

        const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
        for(let d=1; d<=daysInMonth; d++) {
          const dateStr = `${y}-${pad2(m)}-${pad2(d)}`;
          const dayShifts = shiftsByDate.get(dateStr) || [];

          let html = `<div class="iosDay ${today===dateStr?'today':''}" onclick="Roster.openModal('${dateStr}')"><div class="num">${d}</div>`;

          dayShifts.forEach(s => {
            const isLeave = s.work_type === 'leave';
            const color = s.staff_color || '#0f766e';
            const style = isLeave ? 'background:#fee2e2; color:#b91c1c;' :
              (s.staff_color ? `background:${color}20; color:${color}; border-left:2px solid ${color};` : 'background:#ccfbf1; color:#0f766e;');
            const txt = isLeave ? `ลา(${s.staff_name})` : `${s.staff_name}`;
            const tm = isLeave ? '' : `<span style="opacity:0.7;">${escapeHtml((s.start_time||'').slice(0,5))}</span>`;

            html += `<div class="eventPill" style="${style}">${escapeHtml(txt)} ${tm}</div>`;
          });

          grid.innerHTML += html + `</div>`;
        }
        this.currentShifts = shifts;
      },

      openModal(date) {
        $('rosterSelectedDate').value = date;
        $('rosterDateTitle').innerText = `จัดการเวรวันที่ ${new Date(date).toLocaleDateString('th-TH', {day:'numeric', month:'short'})}`;

        const list = $('rosterList'); list.innerHTML = '';
        const existing = this.currentShifts.filter(s => safeText(s.date).slice(0,10) === date);

        if(existing.length === 0) list.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#94a3b8;text-align:center;padding:12px;font-weight:800;">- ยังไม่มีรายการ -</div>';
        else existing.forEach(s => {
          const isLeave = s.work_type === 'leave';
          const div = document.createElement('div');
          div.className = `shift-row ${isLeave?'leave':'work'}`;
          const timeInfo = isLeave ? '<b>ลาหยุด</b>' : `${escapeHtml((s.start_time||'').slice(0,5))} - ${escapeHtml((s.end_time||'').slice(0,5))}`;
          const note = s.note ? `(${escapeHtml(s.note)})` : '';

          div.innerHTML = `
            <div>
              <strong style="font-weight:900;">${escapeHtml(s.staff_name)}</strong> <small style="color:#64748b; font-weight:800;">(${escapeHtml(s.staff_role)})</small><br>
              <span style="color:#334155; font-weight:800;">${timeInfo} ${note}</span>
            </div>
            <button class="btn btn-sm btn-danger" onclick="Roster.deleteShift('${escapeHtml(s.id)}')">ลบ</button>
          `;
          list.appendChild(div);
        });

        $('rosterStaffId').value = '';
        document.querySelector('input[name="workType"][value="work"]').checked = true;
        this.toggleLeave();
        $('rosterStart').value='11:00'; $('rosterEnd').value='20:00'; $('rosterNote').value='';

        Modal.open('rosterModal');
      },

      toggleLeave() {
        const t = document.querySelector('input[name="workType"]:checked').value;
        $('workTimeBox').style.display = t==='leave' ? 'none' : 'block';
      },

      async save() {
        const staffId = $('rosterStaffId').value;
        if(!staffId) return Toast.show('กรุณาเลือกพนักงาน', 'error');

        const payload = {
          staff_id: staffId,
          date: $('rosterSelectedDate').value,
          work_type: document.querySelector('input[name="workType"]:checked').value,
          start_time: $('rosterStart').value,
          end_time: $('rosterEnd').value,
          note: $('rosterNote').value
        };

        const res = await api('/api/save_roster', 'POST', payload);
        if(res && res.__http_ok === false) return Toast.show(`บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ: ${res.__error}`, 'error');

        if(res && res.success) {
          Toast.show('บันทึกสำเร็จ');
          Modal.close('rosterModal');
          this.load();
        } else {
          Toast.show('เกิดข้อผิดพลาด', 'error');
        }
      },

      async deleteShift(id) {
        if(!confirm('ยืนยันลบรายการนี้?')) return;
        const res = await api('/api/delete_roster', 'POST', {id});
        if(res && res.__http_ok === false) return Toast.show(`ลบไม่สำเร็จ: ${res.__error}`, 'error');

        if(res && res.success) {
          this.load();
          Modal.close('rosterModal');
          Toast.show('ลบแล้ว');
        } else {
          Toast.show('ลบไม่สำเร็จ', 'error');
        }
      }
    };

    // --- SETTINGS ---
    const Settings = {
      async load() {
        const box = $('staffListContainer');
        box.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:16px; text-align:center; color:#64748b; font-weight:800;">กำลังโหลด...</div>';

        const staffs = await api('/api/staffs');
        box.innerHTML = '';

        if(staffs && staffs.__http_ok === false) {
          box.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:16px; text-align:center; color:#ef4444; font-weight:800;">โหลดไม่สำเร็จ: ${staffs.__error}</div>`;
          return;
        }
        if(!staffs || staffs.length === 0) {
          box.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:16px; text-align:center; color:#94a3b8; font-weight:800;">ยังไม่มีพนักงาน</div>';
          return;
        }

        staffs.forEach(s => {
          const div = document.createElement('div');
          div.style.cssText = "padding:10px 12px; border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:10px;";
          div.innerHTML = `
            <div style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; min-width:0;">
              <div style="width:26px; height:26px; border-radius:50%; background:${escapeHtml(s.color_code||'#ccc')}; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; color:#fff; font-weight:900;">${escapeHtml((s.name||'?').charAt(0))}</div>
              <div style="min-width:0;">
                <div style="font-weight:900; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;">${escapeHtml(s.name)}</div>
                <div style="color:#64748b; font-weight:800;">${escapeHtml(s.role)}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button class="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" style="color:#ef4444;" onclick="Settings.del(${s.id})">ลบ</button>
          `;
          box.appendChild(div);
        });
      },

      async addStaff() {
        const name = $('newStaffName').value;
        const role = $('newStaffRole').value;
        const color = $('newStaffColor').value;
        if(!name) return Toast.show('กรุณากรอกชื่อ', 'error');

        const res = await api('/api/staffs', 'POST', {name, role, color_code: color});
        if(res && res.__http_ok === false) return Toast.show(`เพิ่มไม่สำเร็จ: ${res.__error}`, 'error');

        if(res && res.success) {
          Toast.show('เพิ่มพนักงานแล้ว');
          $('newStaffName').value = '';
          this.load();
          Roster.loadStaffs();
        } else {
          Toast.show('เกิดข้อผิดพลาด', 'error');
        }
      },

      async del(id) {
        if(!confirm('ลบพนักงานคนนี้?')) return;
        try {
          const r = await fetch(`/api/staffs?id=${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
          if(!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
          Toast.show('ลบสำเร็จ');
          this.load();
          Roster.loadStaffs();
        } catch(e) { Toast.show('ลบไม่สำเร็จ', 'error'); }
      }
    };

    // Tab switching
    document.querySelector('.chip[data-tab="settings"]').addEventListener('click', () => Settings.load());

    document.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(el => {
      el.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
        el.classList.add('active');

        document.querySelectorAll('.panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
        const tab = el.dataset.tab;
        $(`panel-${tab}`).classList.add('active');

        if(tab === 'monthly') Roster.load();
        if(tab === 'monthqueue') MonthQueue.load(false);
        if(tab === 'daily') Daily.load();
      });
    });

    // Init
    Daily.init();
    Roster.init();
    MonthQueue.syncCustomRangeUI();
    MonthQueue.load(false);

    
  </script>

  <script>(function(){
  'use strict';

  const BLANK_AVATAR = '';
  let current = { opd: '', data: null, pitchLoaded: false, pitchOffset: 0 };
  let unassignedLibraryItems = [];
  const oldOpenCustomerModal = window.openCustomerModal;
  const oldCloseCustomerModal = window.closeCustomerModal;

  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  const clean = (s) => String(s ?? '').trim();
  const normalizeFatCategoryText = (s) => clean(s).replace(/Fat\s*\/\s*Hifu\s*\/\s*ปากกา/gi, 'ลดไขมัน').replace(/Fat\s*\/\s*Hifu/gi, 'ลดไขมัน');
  const fmtMoney = (v) => Math.round(Number(v || 0)).toLocaleString();
  const fmtDate = (d) => {
    const s = String(d || '').slice(0,10);
    if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s)) return '-';
    const [y,m,day] = s.split('-');
    return `${day}/${m}/${String(y).slice(-2)}`;
  };
  const pad4 = (v) => {
    const raw = String(v ?? '').trim();
    if(!raw) return '';
    const digits = raw.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if(!digits) return '';
    const opd = digits.padStart(4, '0').slice(-4);
    return opd === '0000' ? '' : opd;
  };
  const decodeKey = (raw) => {
    const s = String(raw ?? '');
    try { return decodeURIComponent(s); } catch { return s; }
  };


  const NAME_COLOR_LABELS = { green: 'เขียว', orange: 'ส้ม', red: 'แดง', gold: 'ทอง VIP' };
  const NAME_COLOR_NOTES = { green: 'ปกติ', orange: 'ระวัง', red: 'Blacklist', gold: 'VIP หมอดูแลเอง' };
  let nameColorMap = {};
  let nameColorPromise = null;
  let nameColorObserver = null;

  function normalizeNameColor(value){
    const c = clean(value).toLowerCase();
    if(c === 'ทอง' || c === 'vip' || c === 'golden') return 'gold';
    return (c === 'red' || c === 'orange' || c === 'green' || c === 'gold') ? c : 'green';
  }
  function colorClass(color){ return `name-color-${normalizeNameColor(color)}`; }
  function customerColorByOpd(opd){
    const o = pad4(opd);
    return normalizeNameColor(nameColorMap[o]?.name_color || 'green');
  }
  function customerColorNoteByOpd(opd){
    const o = pad4(opd);
    return clean(nameColorMap[o]?.name_color_note || '');
  }
  function customerColorFromData(data){
    const c = data?.customer || {};
    return normalizeNameColor(c.name_color || nameColorMap[pad4(data?.opd)]?.name_color || 'green');
  }
  function customerColorNoteFromData(data){
    const c = data?.customer || {};
    return clean(c.name_color_note || nameColorMap[pad4(data?.opd)]?.name_color_note || '');
  }

  async function loadCustomerNameColors(force=false){
    if(nameColorPromise && !force) return nameColorPromise;
    nameColorPromise = fetch('/api/customer_name_colors', {credentials:'same-origin'})
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(data => {
        nameColorMap = data && data.colors ? data.colors : {};
        applyCustomerNameColors(document);
        return data;
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.warn('โหลดสีชื่อลูกค้าไม่สำเร็จ:', err);
        nameColorMap = nameColorMap || {};
        return {schema_ready:false, colors:{}};
      });
    return nameColorPromise;
  }

  function decodeHtmlAttrText(s){
    return String(s || '')
      .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
      .replace(/&#34;/g, '"')
      .replace(/&#39;/g, "'")
      .replace(/&apos;/g, "'")
      .replace(/&amp;/g, '&');
  }

  function opdFromOpenCustomerCall(text){
    const raw0 = decodeHtmlAttrText(text || '');
    if(!raw0) return '';

    const candidates = [raw0];
    try {
      const decoded = decodeURIComponent(raw0);
      if(decoded && decoded !== raw0) candidates.push(decoded);
    } catch(_) {}

    // รองรับทั้ง openCustomerModal('OPD:0025'), openCustomerModal('opd%3A0025'),
    // openCustomerProfile('0025'), data-open-profile และ onclick ที่ฝัง key แบบ OPD:xxxx
    const patterns = [
      /(?:OPD|opd)\s*:\s*([0-9]{1,8})/i,
      /(?:OPD|opd)%3A([0-9]{1,8})/i,
      /openCustomer(?:Modal|Profile)\(\s*['"]\s*(?:OPD|opd)\s*:\s*([0-9]{1,8})/i,
      /openCustomer(?:Modal|Profile)\(\s*['"]\s*([0-9]{1,8})\s*['"]/i,
      /data-(?:open-profile|customer-opd|name-color-opd|opd)\s*=\s*['"]?([0-9]{1,8})/i
    ];
    for(const raw of candidates){
      for(const re of patterns){
        const m = raw.match(re);
        if(m && m[1]) return pad4(m[1]);
      }
    }
    return '';
  }

  function readOpdFromElement(el){
    if(!el) return '';
    const own = el.dataset?.customerOpd || el.dataset?.nameColorOpd || el.dataset?.openProfile || el.dataset?.opd || '';
    if(own) return pad4(own);

    const onclick = el.getAttribute?.('onclick') || '';
    const fromClick = opdFromOpenCustomerCall(onclick);
    if(fromClick) return fromClick;

    const href = el.getAttribute?.('href') || '';
    const fromHref = opdFromOpenCustomerCall(href);
    if(fromHref) return fromHref;

    const row = el.closest?.('[data-customer-opd],[data-name-color-opd],[data-open-profile],[data-opd]');
    if(row){
      const v = row.dataset?.customerOpd || row.dataset?.nameColorOpd || row.dataset?.openProfile || row.dataset?.opd || '';
      if(v) return pad4(v);
      const rowClick = row.getAttribute?.('onclick') || '';
      const fromRowClick = opdFromOpenCustomerCall(rowClick);
      if(fromRowClick) return fromRowClick;
    }
    return '';
  }

  function isCustomerNameTarget(el){
    if(!el || !el.matches) return false;
    return el.matches([
      '.customer-name-color',
      '.dashboard-mini-name',
      '.debtor-summary-name',
      '.pending-name',
      '.customer-name',
      '.name',
      'a.link',
      'a[onclick*="openCustomer"]',
      'span[onclick*="openCustomer"]',
      'strong[onclick*="openCustomer"]',
      'button[onclick*="openCustomer"]',
      '[data-open-profile]'
    ].join(','));
  }

  function applyNameColorToElement(el, opd){
    const key = pad4(opd);
    if(!el || !key) return;
    const color = customerColorByOpd(key);
    const cls = colorClass(color);
    el.classList.add('customer-name-color', cls);
    ['name-color-green','name-color-orange','name-color-red','name-color-gold'].forEach(c => {
      if(c !== cls) el.classList.remove(c);
    });
    if(el.dataset && !el.dataset.customerOpd) el.dataset.customerOpd = key;
    const note = customerColorNoteByOpd(key);
    if(el.dataset && el.dataset.nameColorBaseTitle == null){
      el.dataset.nameColorBaseTitle = String(el.getAttribute('title') || '')
        .replace(/\s*•\s*(เขียว|ส้ม|แดง|ทอง VIP):.*$/u, '')
        .trim();
    }
    const baseTitle = el.dataset?.nameColorBaseTitle || '';
    if(note && color !== 'green'){
      const tag = `${NAME_COLOR_LABELS[color]}: ${note}`;
      el.setAttribute('title', baseTitle ? `${baseTitle} • ${tag}` : tag);
    }else if(baseTitle){
      el.setAttribute('title', baseTitle);
    }else{
      el.removeAttribute('title');
    }
  }

  function applyNameColorInsideContainer(container, opd){
    const key = pad4(opd);
    if(!container || !key) return;
    if(isCustomerNameTarget(container)){
      applyNameColorToElement(container, key);
      return;
    }

    const targets = container.querySelectorAll?.([
      '.customer-name-color',
      '.dashboard-mini-name',
      '.debtor-summary-name',
      '.pending-name',
      '.customer-name',
      '.name',
      'a.link',
      'a[onclick*="openCustomer"]',
      'span[onclick*="openCustomer"]',
      'strong[onclick*="openCustomer"]',
      '[data-open-profile]'
    ].join(',')) || [];

    let applied = 0;
    targets.forEach(t => {
      if(readOpdFromElement(t) || key){
        applyNameColorToElement(t, key);
        applied++;
      }
    });

    // ตารางบางหน้ามีแค่ <tr data-opd> แต่ชื่ออยู่ td กลาง ๆ และไม่มี class/onclick
    // เลือก cell ที่น่าจะเป็นชื่อเท่านั้น ไม่ย้อมทั้งแถวให้รก
    if(!applied && container.matches?.('tr')){
      const cells = [...container.children || []];
      const guess = cells.find(td => /[ก-๙A-Za-z]/.test(td.textContent || '') && !/^\s*(OPD)?\s*\d+\s*$/.test(td.textContent || ''));
      if(guess) applyNameColorToElement(guess, key);
    }
  }

  function applyCustomerNameColors(root=document){
    const scope = root && root.querySelectorAll ? root : document;
    const selector = [
      '.customer-name-color',
      '[data-customer-opd]',
      '[data-name-color-opd]',
      '[data-open-profile]',
      '[data-opd]',
      '[onclick*="openCustomerModal"]',
      '[onclick*="openCustomerProfile"]',
      '.dashboard-mini-name',
      '.debtor-summary-name',
      '.pending-name',
      '.customer-entry .customer-name'
    ].join(',');
    scope.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(el => {
      const opd = readOpdFromElement(el);
      if(!opd) return;
      applyNameColorInsideContainer(el, opd);
    });
  }

  function observeCustomerNameColors(){
    if(nameColorObserver || !document.body) return;
    let pending = false;
    nameColorObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
      if(pending) return;
      pending = true;
      requestAnimationFrame(() => { pending = false; applyCustomerNameColors(document); });
    });
    nameColorObserver.observe(document.body, {childList:true, subtree:true});
  }

  function renderNameColorPicker(data){
    const color = customerColorFromData(data);
    const note = customerColorNoteFromData(data);
    return `
      <div id="scpNameColorPanel" class="scp-name-color-panel" hidden>
        <div class="scp-name-color-title">เลือกสีชื่อ</div>
        <div class="scp-name-color-options">
          ${['green','orange','red','gold'].map(c => `
            <button type="button" class="scp-name-color-option ${colorClass(c)} ${color === c ? 'active' : ''}" data-scp-name-color="${c}">
              ${esc(NAME_COLOR_LABELS[c])}
            </button>
          `).join('')}
        </div>
        <input id="scpNameColorNote" class="scp-name-color-note" maxlength="500" placeholder="คอมเม้นกลาง" value="${esc(note)}">
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function statusMetaForColor(color){
    const c = normalizeNameColor(color);
    return {
      green: {icon:'🟢', label:'เขียว'},
      orange:{icon:'🟠', label:'ส้ม'},
      red:   {icon:'🔴', label:'แดง'},
      gold:  {icon:'💎', label:'ทอง VIP'}
    }[c];
  }

  function snapshotText(...parts){
    return parts.map(clean).filter(Boolean).join(' • ');
  }

  function latestFollowupSnapshot(data){
    const c = data?.customer || {};
    const p = data?.pitch?.latest_followup || {};
    const status = c.last_followup_status || p.outcome || '';
    const comment = c.last_followup_comment || p.content || '';
    const score = c.last_followup_score ?? p.followup_score;
    const scoreText = score === null || score === undefined || score === '' ? '' : `${score}/10`;
    return snapshotText(status, comment, scoreText);
  }

  function latestPitchSnapshot(data){
    const c = data?.customer || {};
    const p = data?.pitch?.latest_pitch || {};
    return snapshotText(c.last_pitch_outcome || p.outcome || '', c.last_pitch_comment || p.content || '');
  }

  function renderCustomerStatusBanner(data){
    const color = customerColorFromData(data);
    const meta = statusMetaForColor(color);
    const mainNote = customerColorNoteFromData(data) || (color === 'gold' ? 'VIP หมอดูแลเอง / ห้ามเซลแตะต้อง' : '');
    const followupText = latestFollowupSnapshot(data);
    const pitchText = latestPitchSnapshot(data);
    const rows = [
      `<div class="scp-status-line"><span class="scp-status-dot">${esc(meta.icon)}</span><span class="scp-status-note">${esc(mainNote || '-')}</span></div>`,
      followupText ? `<div class="scp-status-line"><span class="scp-status-dot">🟡</span><span class="scp-status-note">${esc(followupText)}</span></div>` : '',
      pitchText ? `<div class="scp-status-line"><span class="scp-status-dot">💬</span><span class="scp-status-note">${esc(pitchText)}</span></div>` : ''
    ].filter(Boolean).join('');
    return `
      <div class="scp-status-banner scp-status-${color}" id="scpCustomerStatusBanner">
        <div class="scp-status-lines">${rows}</div>
        <button type="button" class="scp-status-edit" id="scpStatusEditBtn">แก้</button>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function wireNameColorPicker(){
    const panel = $('scpNameColorPanel');
    const titleBtn = $('scpNameTitleBtn');
    const opdBtn = $('scpNameOpdBtn');
    const statusBtn = $('scpStatusEditBtn');
    const toggle = (e) => {
      e?.stopPropagation?.();
      if(!panel) return;
      panel.hidden = !panel.hidden;
    };
    [titleBtn, opdBtn, statusBtn].forEach(btn => btn?.addEventListener('click', toggle));
    panel?.querySelectorAll('[data-scp-name-color]').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const color = btn.dataset.scpNameColor;
        const note = clean($('scpNameColorNote')?.value || '');
        await saveCustomerNameColor(color, note);
      });
    });
  }

  async function saveCustomerNameColor(color, note){
    if(!current.opd) return;
    try{
      const data = await fetchJson('/api/customer_name_color', {
        method:'POST',
        headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
        body: JSON.stringify({opd: current.opd, name_color: color, name_color_note: note || ''})
      });
      const normalized = normalizeNameColor(data.name_color || color);
      nameColorMap[current.opd] = {
        name_color: normalized,
        name_color_note: data.name_color_note || note || '',
        name_color_updated_at: data.name_color_updated_at || new Date().toISOString()
      };
      if(current.data && current.data.customer){
        current.data.customer.name_color = normalized;
        current.data.customer.name_color_note = data.name_color_note || note || '';
        current.data.customer.name_color_updated_at = data.name_color_updated_at || '';
      }
      renderAll(current.data);
      applyCustomerNameColors(document);
    }catch(err){
      alert(err.message || 'บันทึกสีชื่อไม่สำเร็จ');
    }
  }

  function getLocalRecords(){
    const pools = [
      window.allCustomerRecords,
      window.allSalesRecords,
      window.allSales,
      window.salesRecords,
      window.customerRecords,
    ];
    const out = [];
    pools.forEach(p => { if(Array.isArray(p)) out.push(...p); });
    return out;
  }

  function localResolveOpd(rawKey){
    if(rawKey && typeof rawKey === 'object') return pad4(rawKey.opd || rawKey.OPD || rawKey.id);
    let key = decodeKey(rawKey).trim();
    if(!key) return '';
    const lower = key.toLowerCase();
    if(lower.startsWith('opd:')) return pad4(key.split(':', 2)[1]);
    if(key.toUpperCase().startsWith('OPD:')) return pad4(key.split(':', 2)[1]);
    if(/^\d{1,4}$/.test(key)) return pad4(key);
    if(lower.startsWith('np:')) key = key.split(':', 2)[1] || '';
    if(key.includes('|')){
      const [name, phone=''] = key.split('|');
      const n = clean(name).toLowerCase();
      const p = String(phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
      const rows = getLocalRecords();
      const found = rows.find(r => clean(r.name).toLowerCase() === n && String(r.phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '') === p && pad4(r.opd));
      if(found) return pad4(found.opd);
    }
    return '';
  }

  async function resolveOpd(rawKey){
    const local = localResolveOpd(rawKey);
    if(local) return local;
    const key = decodeKey(rawKey);
    const res = await fetch(`/api/customer_profile_lookup?key=${encodeURIComponent(key)}`);
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error('ไม่พบ OPD ของลูกค้านี้');
    const data = await res.json();
    const opd = pad4(data.opd);
    if(!opd) throw new Error('ไม่พบ OPD ของลูกค้านี้');
    return opd;
  }

  async function fetchJson(url, options){
    const res = await fetch(url, options);
    let data = null;
    try { data = await res.json(); } catch { data = {}; }
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || data.message || 'โหลดข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ');
    return data;
  }

  function openModalShell(){
    const modal = $('scp-modal');
    if(modal){ modal.classList.add('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false'); }
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  }
  function closeModal(){
    const modal = $('scp-modal');
    if(modal){ modal.classList.remove('open'); modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); }
    hideCustomerEditTab();
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }
  function setLoading(message){
    openModalShell();
    $('scp-title').textContent = 'ข้อมูลลูกค้า';
    $('scpSubtitle').textContent = message || 'กำลังโหลด...';
    $('scpAvatar').src = BLANK_AVATAR;
    $('scpBadges').innerHTML = '';
    ['Overview','Profile','Edit','Pitch','Party','Gallery'].forEach(name => {
      const el = $(`scpTab${name}`);
      if(el) el.innerHTML = `<div class="scp-card scp-muted">${esc(message || 'กำลังโหลด...')}</div>`;
    });
    switchTab('overview');
  }

  function switchTab(name){
    document.querySelectorAll('.scp-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.scpTab === name));
    document.querySelectorAll('.scp-tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
    const target = $('scpTab' + name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + name.slice(1));
    if(target) target.classList.add('active');
  }

  function firstValue(obj, keys, fallback = 0){
    for(const key of keys){
      if(!obj || obj[key] === undefined || obj[key] === null) continue;
      const value = String(obj[key]).trim();
      if(value !== '') return obj[key];
    }
    return fallback;
  }

  function rowDateScore(row){
    const dateRaw = firstValue(row, ['date', 'sale_date', 'created_at', 'updated_at'], '');
    const dateScore = Date.parse(String(dateRaw || '').slice(0, 10)) || 0;
    const createdScore = Date.parse(firstValue(row, ['created_at', 'updated_at'], '')) || 0;
    const idScore = Number(firstValue(row, ['id', 'sale_id'], 0)) || 0;
    return (dateScore * 1000000000000) + (createdScore || 0) + idScore;
  }

  function latestSaleRow(data){
    const sales = Array.isArray(data.sales_history) ? data.sales_history : [];
    if(!sales.length) return null;
    return sales.slice().sort((a, b) => rowDateScore(b) - rowDateScore(a))[0] || sales[0];
  }

  function remainingArAmount(data){
    // ใช้ “ยอดเหลือค้างชำระล่าสุดของลูกค้าคนนั้น” เท่านั้น
    // ห้ามบวกยอดค้างหลายบิล เพราะจะทำให้หนี้ค้างบวมผิด
    // ห้ามรวม ar_paid_amount เพราะช่องนั้นคือเงินที่ลูกค้ากลับมาจ่ายหนี้เก่าแล้ว
    const latest = latestSaleRow(data);
    if(!latest) return 0;
    const remaining = Number(firstValue(latest, [
      'ar_amount',
      'remaining_ar_amount',
      'remaining_unpaid_amount',
      'unpaid_amount'
    ], 0)) || 0;
    return Math.max(0, remaining);
  }

  function renderMetaLine(data){
    const c = data.customer || {};
    const color = customerColorFromData(data);
    return `
      <div class="scp-meta-line">
        <button type="button" class="scp-meta-item scp-opd-color-trigger ${colorClass(color)}" id="scpNameOpdBtn" title="กดเลือกสีชื่อ"><strong>OPD</strong> ${esc(data.opd || '-')}</button>
        <span class="scp-meta-dot">•</span>
        <span class="scp-meta-item"><strong>เบอร์</strong> ${esc(c.phone || '-')}</span>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function renderBadges(data){
    const c = data.customer || {};
    const badges = [];
    if(clean(c.vip)) badges.push(`<span class="scp-badge vip">VIP ${esc(c.vip)}</span>`);
    const birthMonth = clean(c.birthMonth || c.birth_month || c.birth_month_th || '');
    if(birthMonth) badges.push(`<span class="scp-badge birth">เดือนเกิด ${esc(birthMonth)}</span>`);
    const remainingAr = remainingArAmount(data);
    if(remainingAr > 0) badges.push(`<span class="scp-badge debt">เหลือค้างชำระ ${fmtMoney(remainingAr)} บาท</span>`);
    return badges.join('');
  }

  function saleItemsHtml(row){
    const items = Array.isArray(row.items_structured) && row.items_structured.length
      ? row.items_structured
      : (Array.isArray(row.items) ? row.items.map(x => ({display: x, qty: 1})) : []);
    if(!items.length) return '<li class="scp-sale-item-empty">-</li>';
    return items.map(it => {
      const name = normalizeFatCategoryText(it.display || it.name || it.label || '-');
      const qty = it.qty || it.count || 1;
      return `<li><span class="scp-sale-item-name">${esc(name)}</span><span class="scp-sale-item-qty">× ${esc(qty)}</span></li>`;
    }).join('');
  }

  function displayCustomerName(customer, fallback, opd){
    const nick = clean(customer?.name);
    const full = clean(customer?.full_name);
    if(nick){
      const firstName = full.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)[0] || '';
      if(firstName && !nick.includes(firstName)) return `${nick} ${firstName}`;
      return nick;
    }
    if(full) return full.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 1).join(' ') || full;
    return clean(fallback) || (opd ? `OPD ${opd}` : 'ข้อมูลลูกค้า');
  }

  function dashboardItemSummaryHtml(topItems){
    const source = Array.isArray(topItems) ? topItems.slice(0, 80) : [];
    if(!source.length) return '-';
    const categoryMap = {
      "โบทอค": ["Aestox 50 u", "Aestox 100 u", "Allergan 50 u", "Allergan 100 u", "เฉพาะจุด", "แบ่งไว้แล้ว", "Nabota"],
      "ฟิลเลอร์": ["Neuramis สีดำ", "Neuramis สีทอง", "E.P.T.Q ระบุสีด้วย", "E.P.T.Q", "Restylane ระบุสีด้วย", "Restylane", "Ex-Filler"],
      "ลดไขมัน": ["Bromi", "Sisi", "HIFU", "HIFU แถม"],
      "งานผิว": ["Meso Chanel", "P - Cell", "Aquatic", "Hestina", "Exosome", "Rejuran", "Belotero Revive", "Sculptra", "Juvelook", "Aesthefill", "PRP", "Mesowink", "สะกิดหน้าใส", "Alphaarbutin", "Transamine", "Biocollagen"],
      "ดริปผิว": ["Snow White", "Super Aurawhite", "Vitamin Mix", "Brain Booster", "Energy Booster"],
      "ทรีทเม้นท์": ["ทรีทเมนต์หน้าใส", "ทรีทเมนต์สิว", "ทรีทเมนต์ฝ้า", "ผลักวิตามิน", "ปั่น RF", "กดสิว", "subcisionสิว"],
      "อื่นๆ": ["ยาฉีดสลายฝ้า", "ครีมทาฝ้า", "ยาทานฝ้า", "ไหมลิฟท์กรอบหน้า", "ไหม PDO", "ไหม Collagen", "จ่ายเงิน/จองสินค้า", "สลายฟิลเลอร์", "PRPผม", "จี้ไฝ"],
      "โปรโมชั่น/อีเว้นพิเศษ": []
    };
    const normalized = source.map(it => ({ name: normalizeFatCategoryText(it.name || it.display || it.label), qty: Number(it.qty || it.count || 1) || 1 })).filter(x => x.name);
    const used = new Set();
    const groups = {};
    for(const [cat, names] of Object.entries(categoryMap)){
      names.forEach(n => {
        const found = normalized.find(x => !used.has(x.name) && x.name === n);
        if(found){ (groups[cat] ||= []).push(`${esc(found.name)} : ${esc(found.qty)}`); used.add(found.name); }
      });
    }
    normalized.forEach(x => { if(!used.has(x.name)) (groups['อื่นๆ'] ||= []).push(`${esc(x.name)} : ${esc(x.qty)}`); });
    return Object.entries(groups).filter(([,items]) => items.length).map(([cat, items]) => `
      <div class="scp-item-summary-line"><strong>${esc(cat)}</strong>: ${items.join(' | ')}</div>
    `).join('') || '-';
  }

  function renderOverview(data){
    const s = data.sales_summary || {};
    const sales = data.sales_history || [];
    const daysAbsentText = s.days_since_last_visit == null || s.days_since_last_visit === '' ? '-' : `${esc(s.days_since_last_visit)} วัน`;
    const itemSummary = dashboardItemSummaryHtml(s.top_items || []);
    const history = sales.map(r => `
      <article class="scp-dashboard-sale">
        <div class="scp-dashboard-sale-head">
          <div class="scp-dashboard-sale-date"><span>วันที่</span><strong>${fmtDate(r.date)}</strong></div>
