          <div class="scp-dashboard-sale-money"><span>ยอดบิล</span><strong>${fmtMoney(r.amount)}</strong><small>บาท</small></div>
        </div>
        <ul class="scp-dashboard-sale-items">${saleItemsHtml(r)}</ul>
        ${r.note ? `<div class="scp-sale-note"><strong>Note</strong><span>${esc(r.note)}</span></div>` : ''}
      </article>
    `).join('') || '<div class="scp-card scp-muted">ยังไม่มีประวัติซื้อ</div>';

    $('scpTabOverview').innerHTML = `
      <div class="scp-dashboard-summary-grid">
        <div class="scp-summary-box total"><span class="scp-summary-label">รวม</span><strong>${fmtMoney(s.total_amount)}</strong></div>
        <div class="scp-summary-box avg"><span class="scp-summary-label">เฉลี่ย</span><strong>${fmtMoney(s.average_amount)}</strong></div>
        <div class="scp-summary-box visits"><span class="scp-summary-label">มา</span><strong>${esc(s.visit_count || 0)}</strong><span>ครั้ง</span></div>
        <div class="scp-summary-box last"><span class="scp-summary-label">ไม่มา</span><strong>${daysAbsentText}</strong></div>
      </div>

      <hr class="scp-soft-hr">

      <div class="scp-dashboard-section-title">📦 สรุปรายการซื้อทั้งหมด:</div>
      <div class="scp-dashboard-item-summary">${itemSummary}</div>

      <hr class="scp-soft-hr">

      <div class="scp-dashboard-section-title">🧾 ประวัติการซื้อย้อนหลัง:</div>
      <div class="scp-dashboard-history">${history}</div>
    `;
  }

  function renderProfile(data){
    const c = data.customer || {};
    const fields = [
      ['OPD', data.opd || c.opd], ['ชื่อเล่น', c.name], ['ชื่อจริง', c.full_name], ['เบอร์', c.phone],
      ['VIP', c.vip], ['สีชื่อ', NAME_COLOR_LABELS[customerColorFromData(data)] || 'เขียว'], ['คอมเม้นกลาง', customerColorNoteFromData(data)], ['Follow up ล่าสุด', latestFollowupSnapshot(data)], ['Sale Pitch ล่าสุด', latestPitchSnapshot(data)], ['เดือนเกิด', c.birthMonth], ['วันเกิด', c.birth_th_ddmmyyyy], ['Facebook', c.facebook_name],
      ['เลขบัตรประชาชน', c.national_id], ['ที่อยู่', c.address], ['Note', c.note], ['Profile / ลักษณะลูกค้า', c.profile], ['Sales Pitch เดิม', c['Sales Pitch']]
    ];
    $('scpTabProfile').innerHTML = `
      <div class="scp-profile-toolbar">
        <button type="button" class="scp-btn secondary scp-profile-edit-btn" id="scpOpenEditBtn">แก้ไข</button>
      </div>
      <div class="scp-info-grid">${fields.map(([k,v]) => `
        <div class="scp-info-item"><div class="scp-info-label">${esc(k)}</div><div class="scp-info-value">${esc(v || '-')}</div></div>
      `).join('')}</div>
    `;
    $('scpOpenEditBtn')?.addEventListener('click', openCustomerEditTab);
  }

  function customerEditValue(customer, key){
    const value = customer && customer[key] != null ? customer[key] : '';
    return String(value);
  }

  function customerVipOptions(currentVip){
    const standard = ['', 'VIP', 'VVIP', 'Gold', 'Silver'];
    const currentValue = clean(currentVip);
    const values = currentValue && !standard.includes(currentValue)
      ? [...standard, currentValue]
      : standard;
    return values.map(value => {
      const label = value || 'ไม่ระบุ';
      return `<option value="${esc(value)}" ${value===currentValue?'selected':''}>${esc(label)}</option>`;
    }).join('');
  }

  function renderCustomerEdit(data){
    const c = data.customer || {};
    $('scpTabEdit').innerHTML = `
      <div class="scp-edit-card">
        <div class="scp-edit-head">
          <div>
            <strong>แก้ไขข้อมูลลูกค้า</strong>
            <div class="scp-muted">OPD ${esc(data.opd || c.opd || '-')} · เลข OPD แก้จากหน้านี้ไม่ได้</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="scp-edit-grid">
          <label class="scp-edit-field"><span>ชื่อเล่น</span><input class="scp-input" id="scpEditName" value="${esc(customerEditValue(c,'name'))}"></label>
          <label class="scp-edit-field"><span>ชื่อจริง</span><input class="scp-input" id="scpEditFullName" value="${esc(customerEditValue(c,'full_name'))}"></label>
          <label class="scp-edit-field"><span>เบอร์โทร</span><input class="scp-input" id="scpEditPhone" type="tel" value="${esc(customerEditValue(c,'phone'))}"></label>
          <label class="scp-edit-field"><span>เดือนเกิด (01-12)</span><input class="scp-input" id="scpEditBirthMonth" maxlength="2" inputmode="numeric" value="${esc(customerEditValue(c,'birthMonth'))}"></label>
          <label class="scp-edit-field"><span>วันเกิดไทย (dd/mm/yyyy)</span><input class="scp-input" id="scpEditBirthDate" value="${esc(customerEditValue(c,'birth_th_ddmmyyyy'))}"></label>
          <label class="scp-edit-field"><span>Facebook</span><input class="scp-input" id="scpEditFacebook" value="${esc(customerEditValue(c,'facebook_name'))}"></label>
          <label class="scp-edit-field"><span>เลขบัตรประชาชน</span><input class="scp-input" id="scpEditNationalId" value="${esc(customerEditValue(c,'national_id'))}"></label>
          <label class="scp-edit-field"><span>VIP</span><select class="scp-input" id="scpEditVip">${customerVipOptions(c.vip)}</select></label>
          <label class="scp-edit-field scp-edit-wide"><span>ที่อยู่</span><input class="scp-input" id="scpEditAddress" value="${esc(customerEditValue(c,'address'))}"></label>
          <label class="scp-edit-field scp-edit-wide"><span>Profile / สิ่งที่ควรรู้</span><textarea class="scp-textarea" id="scpEditProfile">${esc(customerEditValue(c,'profile'))}</textarea></label>
          <label class="scp-edit-field scp-edit-wide"><span>หมายเหตุ</span><textarea class="scp-textarea" id="scpEditNote">${esc(customerEditValue(c,'note'))}</textarea></label>
        </div>

        <div class="scp-edit-actions">
          <button type="button" class="scp-btn secondary" id="scpCancelEditBtn">ยกเลิก</button>
          <button type="button" class="scp-btn" id="scpSaveEditBtn">บันทึก</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
    $('scpCancelEditBtn')?.addEventListener('click', closeCustomerEditTab);
    $('scpSaveEditBtn')?.addEventListener('click', saveCustomerEdit);
  }

  function showCustomerEditTab(){
    const btn = $('scpEditTabBtn');
    if(btn) btn.hidden = false;
  }

  function hideCustomerEditTab(){
    const btn = $('scpEditTabBtn');
    if(btn) btn.hidden = true;
  }

  function openCustomerEditTab(){
    if(!current.data) return;
    showCustomerEditTab();
    renderCustomerEdit(current.data);
    switchTab('edit');
    setTimeout(()=> $('scpEditName')?.focus(), 30);
  }

  function closeCustomerEditTab(){
    hideCustomerEditTab();
    switchTab('profile');
  }

  function normalizeCustomerBirthMonth(value){
    const digits = String(value || '').replace(/\D/g,'');
    if(!digits) return '';
    const n = Number(digits);
    if(!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 1 || n > 12) return null;
    return String(n).padStart(2,'0');
  }

  async function saveCustomerEdit(){
    if(!current.opd) return;
    const birthMonth = normalizeCustomerBirthMonth($('scpEditBirthMonth')?.value);
    if(birthMonth === null) return alert('เดือนเกิดต้องเป็น 01-12 ค่ะ');

    const saveBtn = $('scpSaveEditBtn');
    const originalText = saveBtn?.textContent || 'บันทึก';
    if(saveBtn){
      saveBtn.disabled = true;
      saveBtn.textContent = 'กำลังบันทึก...';
    }

    const patch = {
      name: clean($('scpEditName')?.value),
      full_name: clean($('scpEditFullName')?.value),
      phone: clean($('scpEditPhone')?.value),
      birthMonth,
      birth_th_ddmmyyyy: clean($('scpEditBirthDate')?.value),
      facebook_name: clean($('scpEditFacebook')?.value),
      national_id: clean($('scpEditNationalId')?.value),
      vip: clean($('scpEditVip')?.value),
      address: clean($('scpEditAddress')?.value),
      profile: clean($('scpEditProfile')?.value),
      note: clean($('scpEditNote')?.value)
    };

    try{
      await fetchJson('/api/update_customer_patch', {
        method:'POST',
        headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
        body:JSON.stringify({opd:current.opd, patch})
      });
      await refreshProfile('profile');
      hideCustomerEditTab();
      try{
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('customerProfileUpdated', {
          detail:{opd:current.opd, customer:current.data?.customer || {}}
        }));
      }catch(_){}
    }catch(err){
      alert(err.message || 'บันทึกข้อมูลลูกค้าไม่สำเร็จ');
    }finally{
      if(saveBtn){
        saveBtn.disabled = false;
        saveBtn.textContent = originalText;
      }
    }
  }

  function renderPitch(data){
    const p = data.pitch || {};
    const latest = p.latest_pitch;
    const latestFollow = p.latest_followup;
    $('scpTabPitch').innerHTML = `
      <div class="scp-card">
        <div class="scp-info-grid">
          <div class="scp-info-item"><div class="scp-info-label">โทรทั้งหมด</div><div class="scp-info-value">${esc(p.call_count || 0)}</div></div>
          <div class="scp-info-item"><div class="scp-info-label">Sale Pitch</div><div class="scp-info-value">${esc(p.pitch_count || 0)}</div></div>
          <div class="scp-info-item"><div class="scp-info-label">Follow up</div><div class="scp-info-value">${esc(p.followup_count || 0)}</div></div>
        </div>
        ${latestFollow ? `<div class="scp-section-title">🟡</div><div class="scp-muted">${esc(latestFollow.outcome || '')}${latestFollow.content ? ' • ' + esc(latestFollow.content) : ''}${latestFollow.followup_score ? ' • ' + esc(latestFollow.followup_score) + '/10' : ''}</div>` : ''}
        ${latest ? `<div class="scp-section-title">💬</div><div class="scp-muted">${esc(latest.outcome || '')}${latest.content ? ' • ' + esc(latest.content) : ''}</div>` : ''}
        <div class="scp-actions" style="margin-top:12px"><button type="button" class="scp-btn" id="scpLoadPitchBtn">โหลดประวัติการโทร</button></div>
      </div>
      <div id="scpPitchList" class="scp-pitch-list" style="margin-top:10px"></div>
    `;
    const btn = $('scpLoadPitchBtn');
    if(btn) btn.addEventListener('click', () => loadPitchHistory(true));
  }

  async function loadPitchHistory(reset){
    if(!current.opd) return;
    if(reset){ current.pitchOffset = 0; $('scpPitchList').innerHTML = '<div class="scp-card scp-muted">กำลังโหลด Pitch...</div>'; }
    const limit = 50;
    const data = await fetchJson(`/api/customer_profile/${encodeURIComponent(current.opd)}/pitches?limit=${limit}&offset=${current.pitchOffset}`);
    const rows = data.rows || [];
    const html = rows.map(r => `
      <article class="scp-pitch-item">
        <div class="scp-sale-head"><span>${esc((r.created_at || '').slice(0,10) || '-')}</span><span>${esc(r.outcome || r.channel || '')}</span></div>
        ${r.promotion ? `<div><strong>โปร:</strong> ${esc(r.promotion)}</div>` : ''}
        <div class="scp-muted" style="margin-top:6px;white-space:pre-wrap">${esc(r.content || '-')}</div>
        ${r.author ? `<div class="scp-sale-note">โดย ${esc(r.author)}</div>` : ''}
      </article>
    `).join('') || '<div class="scp-card scp-muted">ยังไม่มีประวัติ Pitch</div>';
    if(reset) $('scpPitchList').innerHTML = html;
    else $('scpPitchList').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
    current.pitchOffset += rows.length;
    if(data.has_more){
      $('scpPitchList').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', '<button type="button" class="scp-btn secondary" id="scpMorePitchBtn">โหลดเพิ่ม</button>');
      $('scpMorePitchBtn')?.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ e.currentTarget.remove(); loadPitchHistory(false); });
    }
  }

  function renderParty(data){
    const party = data.party || {groups: []};
    const c = data.customer || {};
    const rows = (party.groups || []).map(g => {
      const checked = g.is_member ? 'checked' : '';
      return `<div class="scp-party-item" data-party-id="${esc(g.id)}">
        <div class="scp-party-head">
          <label><input type="checkbox" class="scpPartyCheck" ${checked}> <strong>${esc(g.name)}</strong></label>
          <span class="scp-muted">${g.is_member ? 'อยู่ในปาตี้นี้' : 'ยังไม่ได้อยู่'}</span>
        </div>
        ${g.note ? `<div class="scp-muted" style="margin-top:6px">${esc(g.note)}</div>` : ''}
        <textarea class="scp-textarea scpPartyNote" placeholder="หมายเหตุเฉพาะลูกค้าคนนี้">${esc(g.member_note || '')}</textarea>
        <div class="scp-actions"><button type="button" class="scp-btn secondary scpSavePartyNote">บันทึกหมายเหตุ</button></div>
      </div>`;
    }).join('') || '<div class="scp-card scp-muted">ยังไม่มีปาตี้</div>';
    $('scpTabParty').innerHTML = `
      <div class="scp-party-create">
        <input id="scpNewPartyName" class="scp-input" placeholder="ชื่อปาตี้ใหม่ เช่น VIP เดือนนี้">
        <input id="scpNewPartyNote" class="scp-input" placeholder="หมายเหตุปาตี้">
        <button type="button" class="scp-btn" id="scpCreatePartyBtn">สร้างและใส่เข้า</button>
      </div>
      <div id="scpPartyList" class="scp-party-list">${rows}</div>
    `;
    $('scpCreatePartyBtn')?.addEventListener('click', createPartyAndAdd);
    document.querySelectorAll('.scpPartyCheck').forEach(input => input.addEventListener('change', async (e)=>{
      const box = e.target.closest('.scp-party-item');
      const partyId = box?.dataset.partyId;
      const note = box?.querySelector('.scpPartyNote')?.value || '';
      await fetchJson(`/api/party_focus/customer/${encodeURIComponent(current.opd)}`, {
        method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'},
        body: JSON.stringify({ party_id: partyId, action: e.target.checked ? 'add' : 'remove', customer_name: c.full_name || c.name || '', phone: c.phone || '', note })
      });
      await refreshProfile('party');
    }));
    document.querySelectorAll('.scpSavePartyNote').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', async (e)=>{
      const box = e.target.closest('.scp-party-item');
      const partyId = box?.dataset.partyId;
      const note = box?.querySelector('.scpPartyNote')?.value || '';
      await fetchJson(`/api/party_focus/${encodeURIComponent(partyId)}/members/${encodeURIComponent(current.opd)}`, {
        method: 'PUT', headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({note})
      });
      alert('บันทึกหมายเหตุแล้ว');
    }));
  }

  async function createPartyAndAdd(){
    const name = clean($('scpNewPartyName')?.value);
    const note = clean($('scpNewPartyNote')?.value);
    if(!name) return alert('ใส่ชื่อปาตี้ก่อนค่ะ');
    const c = current.data?.customer || {};
    const created = await fetchJson('/api/party_focus', {method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({name, note})});
    const partyId = created?.group?.id;
    if(!partyId) throw new Error('สร้างปาตี้แล้วแต่ไม่พบ id');
    await fetchJson(`/api/party_focus/customer/${encodeURIComponent(current.opd)}`, {
      method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({party_id: partyId, action:'add', customer_name: c.full_name || c.name || '', phone: c.phone || '', note:''})
    });
    await refreshProfile('party');
  }

  function renderGallery(data){
    const gallery = data.gallery || [];
    const rows = gallery.map(img => `
      <div class="scp-gallery-item" data-img-id="${esc(img.id)}" data-img-url="${esc(img.image_url)}">
        ${img.is_profile ? '<div class="scp-profile-flag">โปรไฟล์</div>' : ''}
        <img src="${esc(img.image_url)}" alt="รูปลูกค้า">
        <div class="scp-gallery-meta">
          <button type="button" class="scp-mini-btn primary scpSetProfileBtn">ตั้งโปรไฟล์</button>
          <button type="button" class="scp-mini-btn danger scpDeleteImageBtn">ลบ</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    `).join('') || '<div class="scp-card scp-muted">ยังไม่มีรูป</div>';
    $('scpTabGallery').innerHTML = `
      <div class="scp-gallery-toolbar">
        <input id="scpGalleryInput" type="file" accept="image/*" multiple>
        <label class="scp-muted"><input id="scpGallerySetProfile" type="checkbox"> ตั้งรูปสุดท้ายเป็นโปรไฟล์</label>
        <button type="button" class="scp-btn" id="scpUploadGalleryBtn">อัปโหลด</button>
        <button type="button" class="scp-btn secondary" id="scpChooseLibraryBtn">เลือกจากคลัง</button>
      </div>
      <div id="scpLibraryPicker" class="scp-library-picker" hidden></div>
      <div class="scp-gallery-grid">${rows}</div>
    `;
    $('scpUploadGalleryBtn')?.addEventListener('click', uploadGallery);
    $('scpChooseLibraryBtn')?.addEventListener('click', toggleUnassignedLibrary);
    document.querySelectorAll('.scp-gallery-item img').forEach(img => img.addEventListener('click', ()=> openImageViewer(img.src)));
    document.querySelectorAll('.scpSetProfileBtn').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', async (e)=>{
      const box = e.target.closest('.scp-gallery-item');
      await fetchJson('/api/set_profile_image', {method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({opd: current.opd, id: box?.dataset.imgId, image_url: box?.dataset.imgUrl})});
      await refreshProfile('gallery');
    }));
    document.querySelectorAll('.scpDeleteImageBtn').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', async (e)=>{
      if(!confirm('ลบรูปนี้ออกจากคลังรูปใช่ไหม')) return;
      const box = e.target.closest('.scp-gallery-item');
      await fetchJson('/api/delete_gallery_image', {method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({id: box?.dataset.imgId})});
      await refreshProfile('gallery');
    }));
  }

  function renderUnassignedLibrary(query=''){
    const panel = $('scpLibraryPicker');
    if(!panel) return;
    const q = clean(query).toLowerCase();
    const items = unassignedLibraryItems.filter(item=>{
      const hay = `${item.cloudinary_public_id||''} ${item.folder||''} ${item.image_type||''}`.toLowerCase();
      return !q || hay.includes(q);
    });
    panel.innerHTML = `
      <div class="scp-library-head">
        <div><strong>รูปที่ยังไม่มี OPD</strong><div class="scp-muted">${items.length} รูป</div></div>
        <input id="scpLibrarySearch" class="scp-input" placeholder="ค้นหารูป / โฟลเดอร์" value="${esc(query)}">
      </div>
      <div class="scp-library-grid">
        ${items.map(item=>`
          <div class="scp-library-item">
            <img src="${esc(item.thumb_url||item.image_url||'')}" alt="รูปจากคลัง" data-library-preview="${esc(item.image_url||'')}">
            <div class="scp-library-meta">${esc(item.folder||item.image_type||'ไม่มี OPD')}</div>
            <button type="button" class="scp-mini-btn primary" data-library-key="${esc(item.key)}">เลือก</button>
          </div>
        `).join('') || '<div class="scp-card scp-muted">ไม่มีรูปที่ยังไม่ได้ผูก OPD</div>'}
      </div>
    `;
    $('scpLibrarySearch')?.addEventListener('input',e=>renderUnassignedLibrary(e.target.value));
    panel.querySelectorAll('[data-library-preview]').forEach(img=>img.addEventListener('click',()=>openImageViewer(img.dataset.libraryPreview)));
    panel.querySelectorAll('[data-library-key]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>attachLibraryImage(btn.dataset.libraryKey)));
  }

  async function toggleUnassignedLibrary(){
    const panel = $('scpLibraryPicker');
    if(!panel) return;
    if(!panel.hidden){
      panel.hidden = true;
      return;
    }
    panel.hidden = false;
    panel.innerHTML = '<div class="scp-card scp-muted">กำลังโหลดรูปที่ยังไม่มี OPD...</div>';
    try{
      const data = await fetchJson('/api/settings/customer-images?scope=unassigned');
      unassignedLibraryItems = Array.isArray(data.items) ? data.items.filter(x=>x.location_group==='non_opd') : [];
      renderUnassignedLibrary('');
    }catch(err){
      panel.innerHTML = `<div class="scp-card scp-muted">โหลดคลังรูปไม่สำเร็จ: ${esc(err.message)}</div>`;
    }
  }

  async function attachLibraryImage(key){
    const item = unassignedLibraryItems.find(x=>String(x.key)===String(key));
    if(!item || !current.opd) return;
    try{
      await fetchJson('/api/settings/customer-images/assign', {
        method:'POST',
        headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
        body: JSON.stringify({
          source:item.source,
          gallery_id:item.gallery_id,
          cloudinary_public_id:item.cloudinary_public_id,
          image_url:item.image_url,
          opd:current.opd,
          set_profile:false
        })
      });
      await refreshProfile('gallery');
    }catch(err){
      alert(err.message || 'เลือกรูปจากคลังไม่สำเร็จ');
    }
  }

  async function uploadGallery(){
    const input = $('scpGalleryInput');
    if(!input || !input.files || !input.files.length) return alert('เลือกรูปก่อนค่ะ');
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append('opd', current.opd);
    fd.append('image_type', 'gallery');
    fd.append('set_profile', $('scpGallerySetProfile')?.checked ? '1' : '0');
    Array.from(input.files).forEach(f => fd.append('images', f));
    await fetchJson('/api/upload_gallery', {method:'POST', body:fd});
    input.value = '';
    await refreshProfile('gallery');
  }

  function renderAll(data){
    current.data = data;
    const c = data.customer || {};
    const displayName = displayCustomerName(c, '', data.opd);
    const color = customerColorFromData(data);
    $('scp-title').innerHTML = `<button type="button" class="scp-title-name-btn ${colorClass(color)}" id="scpNameTitleBtn" title="กดเลือกสีชื่อ">${esc(displayName)}</button>`;
    $('scpSubtitle').innerHTML = renderMetaLine(data);
    const badgesHtml = renderBadges(data);
    $('scpBadges').innerHTML = renderCustomerStatusBanner(data) + (badgesHtml ? `<div class="scp-badge-row">${badgesHtml}</div>` : '') + renderNameColorPicker(data);
    $('scpAvatar').src = data.profile_pic_url || BLANK_AVATAR;
    wireNameColorPicker();
    renderOverview(data); renderProfile(data); renderCustomerEdit(data); renderPitch(data); renderParty(data); renderGallery(data);
    applyCustomerNameColors(document);
  }

  async function refreshProfile(tab){
    if(!current.opd) return;
    const data = await fetchJson(`/api/customer_profile/${encodeURIComponent(current.opd)}`);
    renderAll(data);
    if(tab) switchTab(tab);
  }

  async function openCustomerProfile(rawKey){
    try{
      setLoading('กำลังโหลดข้อมูลลูกค้า...');
      const opd = await resolveOpd(rawKey);
      current = {opd, data:null, pitchLoaded:false, pitchOffset:0};
      hideCustomerEditTab();
      await loadCustomerNameColors();
      const data = await fetchJson(`/api/customer_profile/${encodeURIComponent(opd)}`);
      renderAll(data);
      switchTab('overview');
    }catch(err){
      console.error(err);
      setLoading(err.message || 'โหลดข้อมูลลูกค้าไม่สำเร็จ');
    }
  }

  function openImageViewer(src){
    if(!src) return;
    $('scpImageLarge').src = src;
    $('scp-image-viewer').classList.add('open');
    $('scp-image-viewer').setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
  }
  function closeImageViewer(){
    $('scp-image-viewer').classList.remove('open');
    $('scp-image-viewer').setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    $('scpImageLarge').src = '';
  }

  function wire(){
    $('scpCloseBtn')?.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-scp-close]').forEach(el => el.addEventListener('click', closeModal));
    $('scpImageCloseBtn')?.addEventListener('click', closeImageViewer);
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-scp-image-close]').forEach(el => el.addEventListener('click', closeImageViewer));
    $('scpAvatarBox')?.addEventListener('click', () => openImageViewer($('scpAvatar')?.src));
    document.querySelectorAll('.scp-tab').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', () => switchTab(btn.dataset.scpTab)));
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if(e.key === 'Escape'){ closeImageViewer(); closeModal(); } });
    observeCustomerNameColors();
    loadCustomerNameColors().then(() => applyCustomerNameColors(document));
  }

  window.customerNameColorHtml = (name, opd) => `<span class="customer-name-color ${colorClass(customerColorByOpd(opd))}" data-customer-opd="${esc(pad4(opd))}">${esc(name || '-')}</span>`;
  window.applyCustomerNameColors = applyCustomerNameColors;
  window.loadCustomerNameColors = loadCustomerNameColors;
  window.openCustomerProfile = openCustomerProfile;
  window.closeCustomerProfile = closeModal;
  window.openCustomerModal = function(key){ return openCustomerProfile(key); };
  window.closeCustomerModal = function(){
    closeModal();
    try { if(typeof oldCloseCustomerModal === 'function') oldCloseCustomerModal(); } catch(_) {}
  };
  window.__legacyOpenCustomerModal = oldOpenCustomerModal;

  if(document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', wire);
  else wire();
})();

</script>

#fcs-root #fcs-dialog .fcs-field input,#fcs-root #fcs-dialog .fcs-field select{width:100%;min-width:0!important;max-width:100%;padding:4px 6px;border:1px solid #d1e2d8;background:#fff;border-radius:6px;color:#173a32;min-height:30px!important;line-height:1.3!important}

#fcs-root .fcs-actions{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px;padding-top:8px;border-top:1px solid #e5eee9}
#fcs-root .fcs-actions>.fcs-button{flex:1 1 auto}
#fcs-count{background:#e1eee7;border-radius:4px;padding:1px 4px;margin-left:2px}
#fcs-root #fcs-dialog .fcs-result-heading{margin:10px 0 5px;color:#406858;font-weight:500!important}
#fcs-root .fcs-result{display:flex;gap:4px;border:1px solid #e1ece5;padding:5px;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;margin-bottom:3px}
#fcs-root .fcs-result>div{min-width:0;flex:1}
#fcs-root .fcs-check{display:grid;place-items:start center;padding-top:3px;min-width:20px;cursor:pointer}
#fcs-root #fcs-dialog .fcs-check input{appearance:auto;width:16px;height:16px;min-height:16px!important;padding:0;margin:0;accent-color:#0f766e}
#fcs-root #fcs-dialog .fcs-result-name{padding:0;border:0;background:none;color:#087460;text-align:left;font-weight:500!important;cursor:pointer;min-height:22px!important;line-height:1.4!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#fcs-root .fcs-result-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:2px 8px;margin-top:2px;color:#6a7b72;line-height:1.5}
#fcs-status{margin-top:5px;color:#627d6f}
#fcs-status:empty{display:none}
#fcs-retry{margin-top:5px}
#fcs-root :is(button,input,select):focus-visible{outline:2px solid #7cc5a9;outline-offset:2px}
body.fcs-profile-active #fcs-dialog{visibility:hidden}
body.fcs-profile-active #scp-modal{z-index:10050}
@media(min-width:560px){#fcs-root .fcs-form-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}#fcs-root .fcs-wide{grid-column:1/-1}}
@media(max-width:599px){#fcs-root .fcs-range:has(input[type=date]){grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}#fcs-root .fcs-range:has(input[type=date])>span{display:none}}
/* Keep native form text at 16px on touch devices to avoid iPhone focus zoom.
   Compact control heights and surrounding 10.5px text are unchanged. */
@media(hover:none) and (pointer:coarse){
  #fcs-root #fcs-dialog input:not([type=checkbox]),#fcs-root #fcs-dialog select{font-size:16px!important}
}
@media print{#fcs-root{display:none!important}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#fcs-root *{transition:none!important}}

</style>
<template id="fcs-profile-template"><!-- Central Customer Profile Popup: shared by dashboard/customer_list/sale-summary/crm/tax/record pages -->
<div id="scp-modal" class="scp-modal" aria-hidden="true">
  <div class="scp-backdrop" data-scp-close="1"></div>
  <section class="scp-panel" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="scp-title">
    <header class="scp-header">
      <div class="scp-head-main">
        <div class="scp-avatar" id="scpAvatarBox">
          <img id="scpAvatar" alt="รูปโปรไฟล์ลูกค้า" src="">
        </div>
        <div class="scp-title-wrap">
          <h2 id="scp-title">ข้อมูลลูกค้า</h2>
          <div id="scpSubtitle" class="scp-subtitle">กำลังโหลด...</div>
          <div id="scpBadges" class="scp-badges"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="scp-close" id="scpCloseBtn" aria-label="ปิด">✕</button>
    </header>

    <nav class="scp-tabs" aria-label="แถบข้อมูลลูกค้า">
      <button type="button" class="scp-tab active" data-scp-tab="overview">ภาพรวม</button>
      <button type="button" class="scp-tab" data-scp-tab="profile">ประวัติ</button>
      <button type="button" class="scp-tab scp-edit-tab" data-scp-tab="edit" id="scpEditTabBtn" hidden>แก้ไขข้อมูล</button>
      <button type="button" class="scp-tab" data-scp-tab="pitch">Pitch</button>
      <button type="button" class="scp-tab" data-scp-tab="party">ปาตี้</button>
      <button type="button" class="scp-tab" data-scp-tab="gallery">รูป</button>
    </nav>

    <main class="scp-body">
      <section id="scpTabOverview" class="scp-tab-panel active"></section>
      <section id="scpTabProfile" class="scp-tab-panel"></section>
      <section id="scpTabEdit" class="scp-tab-panel"></section>
      <section id="scpTabPitch" class="scp-tab-panel"></section>
      <section id="scpTabParty" class="scp-tab-panel"></section>
      <section id="scpTabGallery" class="scp-tab-panel"></section>
    </main>
  </section>
</div>

<div id="scp-image-viewer" class="scp-image-viewer" aria-hidden="true">
  <div class="scp-image-backdrop" data-scp-image-close="1"></div>
  <div class="scp-image-panel">
    <button type="button" class="scp-image-close" id="scpImageCloseBtn">✕</button>
    <img id="scpImageLarge" src="" alt="ดูรูปใหญ่">
  </div>
</div>
</template>
<script>/* Floating search UI. Uses the Dashboard engine and the existing customer profile popup. */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const assetScript=document.currentScript;
  const profileCSS=assetScript?.dataset.profileCss;
  const profileJS=assetScript?.dataset.profileJs;
  function init(){
    if(document.getElementById('fcs-toggle') || !window.SumoCustomerSearch)return;
    const engine=window.SumoCustomerSearch;
    const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
    const glass='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10.8" cy="10.8" r="6.8"/><path d="m16 16 4.7 4.7" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';
    const host=document.createElement('div');host.id='fcs-root';
    host.innerHTML=`<button type="button" id="fcs-toggle" aria-label="ค้นหาลูกค้าด่วน" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="fcs-dialog">${glass}<span class="fcs-toggle-label">ค้นหาลูกค้า</span></button>
      <div id="fcs-overlay" hidden>
        <div class="fcs-backdrop" data-close></div>
        <section id="fcs-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="fcs-title" tabindex="-1">
          <header class="fcs-header"><span class="fcs-icon">${glass}</span><div><h2 id="fcs-title">ค้นหาลูกค้า</h2><p id="fcs-subtitle">ค้นชื่อ แล้วแตะเพื่อดูรายละเอียด</p></div><button type="button" class="fcs-close" data-close aria-label="ปิดค้นหาลูกค้า">×</button></header>
          <div class="fcs-body" id="fcs-body">
            <section id="fcs-quick"><label class="fcs-searchbox">${glass}<input id="fcs-name" type="search" autocomplete="off" placeholder="พิมพ์ชื่อลูกค้า…" aria-label="ชื่อลูกค้าสำหรับค้นหาเร็ว"></label><div id="fcs-quick-results" class="fcs-results"></div></section>
            <form id="fcs-advanced" hidden>
              <div class="fcs-form-grid">
                <div class="fcs-field fcs-wide"><div class="fcs-field-heading"><span>สินค้าที่เคยซื้อ</span><button type="button" class="fcs-button fcs-small" id="fcs-add-product">＋ เพิ่มสินค้า</button></div><div id="fcs-products"></div></div>
                <div class="fcs-field"><span>ช่วงวันที่รับบริการ</span><div class="fcs-range"><input type="date" name="startDate" aria-label="วันที่เริ่มต้น"><span>ถึง</span><input type="date" name="endDate" aria-label="วันที่สิ้นสุด"></div></div>
                ${[['ยอดใช้จ่ายรวม','Total'],['จำนวนครั้งที่มาใช้บริการ','Visits'],['จำนวนวันที่ไม่ได้กลับมา','Absent'],['ยอดเฉลี่ยต่อบิล','Avg']].map(([label,key])=>`<div class="fcs-field"><span>${label}</span><div class="fcs-range"><input type="number" step="any" name="min${key}" placeholder="ขั้นต่ำ" aria-label="${label}ขั้นต่ำ"><span>ถึง</span><input type="number" step="any" name="max${key}" placeholder="สูงสุด" aria-label="${label}สูงสุด"></div></div>`).join('')}
                <label class="fcs-field"><span>ชื่อลูกค้า</span><input type="search" name="nameInput" placeholder="พิมพ์ชื่อที่ต้องการค้นหา"></label>
              </div>
              <div class="fcs-actions"><button class="fcs-button fcs-primary" type="submit">ค้นหาลูกค้า</button><button class="fcs-button" type="button" id="fcs-reset">ล้างตัวกรอง</button><button class="fcs-button" type="button" id="fcs-selected">ดูรายการที่เลือก <span id="fcs-count">0</span></button></div>
              <div id="fcs-advanced-results" class="fcs-results"></div>
            </form>
            <section id="fcs-group" hidden><button class="fcs-button" type="button" id="fcs-back-group">‹ กลับผลค้นหา</button><div id="fcs-group-results" class="fcs-results"></div></section>
            <div id="fcs-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div><button class="fcs-button" id="fcs-retry" type="button" hidden>ลองใหม่</button>
          </div>
          <footer class="fcs-footer"><button class="fcs-button fcs-mode-button" id="fcs-mode" type="button">ค้นหาแบบละเอียด <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button></footer>
        </section>
      </div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(host);
    const $=id=>host.querySelector('#fcs-'+id);
    let records=null,recordIndex=new Map(),rows=[],quickRows=[],selected=new Set(),mode='quick',opened=false,loading=false,previousFocus=null,profileFocus=null,profilePromise=null,searchTimer=null;
    const form=$('advanced');
    const profileOpen=()=>document.getElementById('scp-modal')?.classList.contains('open');
    const imageOpen=()=>document.getElementById('scp-image-viewer')?.classList.contains('open');
    const setStatus=text=>{$('status').textContent=text;};
    function switchMode(next){
      mode=next;host.dataset.mode=next;
      $('quick').hidden=next!=='quick';form.hidden=next!=='advanced';$('group').hidden=next!=='group';
      $('mode').hidden=next==='group';
      $('mode').innerHTML=next==='quick'?'ค้นหาแบบละเอียด <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>':'‹ กลับค้นหาเร็ว';
      $('title').textContent=next==='quick'?'ค้นหาลูกค้า':next==='advanced'?'ค้นหาแบบละเอียด':'รายการที่เลือก';
      $('subtitle').textContent=next==='quick'?'ค้นชื่อ แล้วแตะเพื่อดูรายละเอียด':next==='advanced'?'ตัวกรองและผลลัพธ์จาก Dashboard':'แตะชื่อเพื่อเปิดข้อมูลลูกค้า';
      $('body').scrollTop=0;
    }
    async function load(){
      loading=true;records=null;$('retry').hidden=true;setStatus('กำลังโหลดรายชื่อลูกค้า…');
      form.querySelector('[type=submit]').disabled=true;
      try{records=await engine.load();recordIndex=engine.indexRecords(records);setStatus('');if(mode==='quick')quickSearch();}
      catch(e){setStatus(e.message||'โหลดข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ');$('retry').hidden=false;}
      finally{loading=false;form.querySelector('[type=submit]').disabled=!records;}
    }
    function open(){
      previousFocus=document.activeElement;opened=true;$('overlay').hidden=false;$('toggle').setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');document.body.classList.add('fcs-open');
      // The existing page menu should not remain underneath a second active dialog.
      const nav=document.getElementById('adminFloatingToggle');if(nav?.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='true')nav.click();
      if(mode==='quick')$('name').focus();else $('dialog').focus();load();
    }
    function close(){
      if(profileOpen())return;
      opened=false;$('overlay').hidden=true;$('toggle').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');document.body.classList.remove('fcs-open');previousFocus?.focus?.();
    }
    function contact(c){
      const phone=String(recordIndex.get(c.key)?.find(r=>String(r.phone??'').trim() && String(r.phone).trim()!=='-')?.phone??'').trim();
      const dial=phone.replace(/[\s().-]/g,'');
      const phoneHtml=/^\+?\d{6,15}$/.test(dial)
        ? `<a class="fcs-phone" href="tel:${dial}" aria-label="โทรหา ${esc(c.name)} ที่ ${esc(phone)}">☎ ${esc(phone)}</a>`
        : `<span class="fcs-phone-missing">${phone?esc(phone):'ไม่มีเบอร์โทร'}</span>`;
      return `<div class="fcs-contact"><span class="fcs-opd">OPD ${esc(c.opd||'-')}</span>${phoneHtml}</div>`;
    }
    function quickSearch(){
      if(!records)return;
      const q=$('name').value.trim().toLowerCase();
      if(!q){$('quick-results').innerHTML='<div class="fcs-empty">พิมพ์ชื่อเพื่อเริ่มค้นหา</div>';quickRows=[];setStatus('');return;}
      quickRows=engine.query(records,{nameInput:q});
      $('quick-results').innerHTML=quickRows.map((c,i)=>`<article class="fcs-quick-row"><button type="button" class="fcs-name customer-name-color" data-name-color-opd="${esc(c.opd)}" data-quick="${i}">${esc(c.name)}</button>${contact(c)}</article>`).join('')||'<div class="fcs-empty">ไม่พบชื่อนี้ ลองพิมพ์ชื่ออีกครั้ง</div>';
      setStatus(quickRows.length?`พบ ${quickRows.length.toLocaleString()} คน`:'');
      window.applyCustomerNameColors?.($('quick-results'));
    }
    function readFilters(){
      const f={nameInput:form.elements.nameInput.value.trim().toLowerCase(),startDate:form.elements.startDate.value,endDate:form.elements.endDate.value,selectedProducts:Array.from($('products').querySelectorAll('select')).map(s=>s.value).filter(Boolean)};
      for(const k of ['Total','Visits','Absent','Avg']){
        const parse=['Visits','Absent'].includes(k)?parseInt:parseFloat;
        f['min'+k]=parse(form.elements['min'+k].value)||0;f['max'+k]=parse(form.elements['max'+k].value)||Infinity;
      }
      return f;
    }
    function advancedSearch(){
      if(!records)return;
      rows=engine.query(records,readFilters());selected.clear();$('count').textContent='0';
      $('advanced-results').innerHTML=`<h3 class="fcs-result-heading">ผลลัพธ์ ${rows.length.toLocaleString()} คน</h3>`+rows.map((c,i)=>`<article class="fcs-result"><label class="fcs-check"><input type="checkbox" data-select="${i}" aria-label="เลือก ${esc(c.name)}"></label><div><button type="button" class="fcs-result-name customer-name-color" data-name-color-opd="${esc(c.opd)}" data-result="${i}">📇 ${esc(c.name)}</button><div class="fcs-result-meta"><span>💰 ยอด: ${c.totalAmount.toLocaleString()}</span><span>💳 ${Math.round(c.averageBill).toLocaleString()}</span><span>🔁 ${c.totalVisits} (${c.paidVisits} จ่าย)</span><span>⏱️ ${c.absentDays} วัน</span><span>${esc(new Date(c.lastVisit).toLocaleDateString('th-TH',{day:'numeric',month:'short',year:'2-digit'}))}</span></div></div></article>`).join('');
      setStatus(rows.length?'':'ไม่พบลูกค้าที่ตรงกับเงื่อนไข');window.applyCustomerNameColors?.($('advanced-results'));
    }
    function addProduct(){
      const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='fcs-product-row';
      row.innerHTML=`<select aria-label="สินค้าที่เคยซื้อ"><option value="" selected disabled>เลือกสินค้าและบริการ</option>${Object.entries(engine.products).map(([cat,items])=>`<optgroup label="${esc(cat)}">${items.map(p=>`<option value="${esc(p)}">${esc(p)}</option>`).join('')}</optgroup>`).join('')}</select><button class="fcs-button" type="button" aria-label="ลบตัวกรองสินค้านี้">ลบ</button>`;
      row.querySelector('button').onclick=()=>row.remove();$('products').appendChild(row);
    }
    function showSelected(){
      const customerIndex=engine.indexRecords(records||[]);
      $('group-results').innerHTML=rows.map((c,i)=>({c,i})).filter(({c})=>selected.has(c.key)).map(({c,i},n)=>{
        const latest=customerIndex.get(c.key)?.[0]||{};
        return `<article class="fcs-result"><div><button class="fcs-result-name" type="button" data-result="${i}">${n+1}. ${esc(c.name)}</button><div class="fcs-result-meta"><span>OPD: ${esc(c.opd||'-')}</span><span>📞 ${esc(latest.phone||'-')}</span><button class="fcs-button fcs-small" type="button" data-result="${i}">เปิดข้อมูล</button></div></div></article>`;
      }).join('')||'<div class="fcs-empty">ยังไม่ได้เลือกลูกค้า (ติ๊กช่องหน้าชื่อก่อน)</div>';
      setStatus('');switchMode('group');$('back-group').focus();
    }
    async function ensureProfile(){
      if(window.openCustomerProfile && document.getElementById('scp-modal'))return;
      if(profilePromise)return profilePromise;
      profilePromise=(async()=>{
        if(!document.getElementById('scp-modal')){
          const template=document.getElementById('fcs-profile-template');
          if(!template)throw new Error('ไม่พบหน้าต่างข้อมูลลูกค้า');
          document.body.appendChild(template.content.cloneNode(true));
        }
        if(!document.querySelector('link[href*="customer_profile_modal.css"]')){
          const css=document.createElement('link');css.rel='stylesheet';css.href=profileCSS;document.head.appendChild(css);
        }
        if(!window.openCustomerProfile){
          await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const s=document.createElement('script');s.src=profileJS;s.onload=resolve;s.onerror=()=>{s.remove();reject(new Error('โหลดหน้าต่างลูกค้าไม่สำเร็จ ลองกดชื่ออีกครั้ง'));};document.body.appendChild(s);});
        }
      })();
      try{await profilePromise;}finally{profilePromise=null;}
    }
    async function detail(c,button){
      if(!c)return;profileFocus=button;button.disabled=true;
      try{
        await ensureProfile();
        const modal=document.getElementById('scp-modal');
        const observer=new MutationObserver(()=>{
          if(!modal.classList.contains('open')){observer.disconnect();$('dialog').inert=false;document.body.classList.remove('fcs-profile-active');if(opened)profileFocus?.focus();}
        });
        observer.observe(modal,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});
        $('dialog').inert=true;document.body.classList.add('fcs-profile-active');
        const result=window.openCustomerProfile(c.key);
        document.getElementById('scpCloseBtn')?.focus();await result;
      }catch(e){$('dialog').inert=false;document.body.classList.remove('fcs-profile-active');setStatus(e.message);}
      finally{button.disabled=false;}
    }
    $('toggle').onclick=open;$('retry').onclick=load;
    host.querySelectorAll('[data-close]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=close);
    $('name').addEventListener('input',()=>{clearTimeout(searchTimer);searchTimer=setTimeout(quickSearch,180);});
    $('name').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();clearTimeout(searchTimer);quickSearch();}});
    $('mode').onclick=()=>{const next=mode==='quick'?'advanced':'quick';if(next==='advanced'&&!form.elements.nameInput.value)form.elements.nameInput.value=$('name').value;switchMode(next);setStatus('');if(next==='quick'){quickSearch();$('name').focus();}else form.elements.nameInput.focus();};
    $('add-product').onclick=addProduct;
    form.onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();advancedSearch();};
    $('reset').onclick=()=>{form.reset();$('products').replaceChildren();$('advanced-results').replaceChildren();rows=[];selected.clear();$('count').textContent='0';setStatus('');};
    $('selected').onclick=showSelected;$('back-group').onclick=()=>{switchMode('advanced');$('selected').focus();};
    host.addEventListener('change',e=>{const i=e.target.dataset.select;if(i===undefined)return;const key=rows[Number(i)]?.key;if(key){e.target.checked?selected.add(key):selected.delete(key);$('count').textContent=selected.size;}});
    host.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-quick],[data-result]');if(b)detail(b.dataset.quick!==undefined?quickRows[Number(b.dataset.quick)]:rows[Number(b.dataset.result)],b);});
    document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
      if(!opened)return;
      if(e.key==='Escape'){
        e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();
        if(imageOpen()){document.getElementById('scpImageCloseBtn')?.click();return;}
        if(profileOpen()){window.closeCustomerProfile?.();return;}
        if(mode==='group'){switchMode('advanced');$('selected').focus();return;}
        close();return;
      }
      if(e.key==='Tab'){
        const active=imageOpen()?document.getElementById('scp-image-viewer'):profileOpen()?document.getElementById('scp-modal'):$('dialog');
        const list=Array.from(active.querySelectorAll('button:not(:disabled),input:not(:disabled),select:not(:disabled),textarea:not(:disabled),a[href],[tabindex="0"]')).filter(el=>el.getClientRects().length&&!el.closest('[hidden]'));
        const first=list[0],last=list.at(-1);if(!first){e.preventDefault();return;}
        if(e.shiftKey&&(document.activeElement===first||!active.contains(document.activeElement))){e.preventDefault();last.focus();}
        else if(!e.shiftKey&&(document.activeElement===last||!active.contains(document.activeElement))){e.preventDefault();first.focus();}
      }
    },true);
    switchMode('quick');
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init,{once:true});else init();
})();

</script>
